In the actual browser, observe the requested clock text, error/readiness state and rendered scene; do not change the OS clock or equate a finite helper result with a qualified picture. Keep default real-time motion/reduced-motion controls, opaque moon and readable 325×530 layout on valid scenes. Record profile builds for repeated same-day hourly/model calls; bounded cache reuse must be observable.

In authorized disposable mutation fixtures, restore the single-offset implementation, choose the first fold entry, remove explicit-zone propagation, and bypass the invalid consumer branch separately. Each corresponding case must fail. Restore the final tree before acceptance. Existing invalid-date behavior in unrelated `partsInTz` callers is a regression control; narrowing the inverse must not globally replace that helper's fallback semantics without separate caller evidence.

## Ownership, rollback and closure

Preserve [R0008](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/8) → [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3) for explicit-zone conversion semantics/captured hourly caller, the conversion interface consumed by [R0007](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/7), and source-epoch qualification in [R000B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11). Coordinate clock-mode writes with [R0020](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/32). One integrator owns overlapping converter/caller and simulation-entry hunks; this adds no directed edge or whole-issue serialization requirement. High-level invalid-scene guards are converter consumer integration, not ownership of prayer request scheduling or Hijri policy. The guard after eligible provider-zone adoption shares `runtime/day-adoption` with [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3), [R0004](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/4), and [R0005](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/5). Serialize those exact adoption/reinitialization hunks with their integrator; keep request, boot-day and promotion ownership distinct. This clarifies a write collision and adds no directed predecessor.

Change index.html's conversion and its necessary actual caller guards plus invoked regression fixtures. DESIGN must state the minute-precision domain, explicit unavailable gap/fold behavior and simulation error boundary; its old one-anchor description is revised jointly with the clock owner. Builder, config schema, presets and installers need no change. No active IMPLEMENTAUDIT controller/state, provider, dependency or deployment is involved.

Rollback converter/profile and dependent validity guards together if valid scenes, weather/current observation independence or countdown callers regress. A NaN-returning converter with unguarded consumers is an unsafe partial state. Completion requires final-tree RED→GREEN/control results, exact-tree independent caller review and browser clock/error/recovery readback before the evidence comment and manual #8 closure; use non-closing `Implements #8`. Public repair claims additionally require matching served source/readback. The historical companion remains supplementary, SHA256 `81ec493202ee83b988415f2d2608a1fc43464111ae21f27a38ddee8e36197dc4`; no new runtime result is claimed here.

Identity provenance: first repository-local allocation batch; existing GitHub object order was used to assign distinct monotonic hex-4 IDs. Closed/held IDs are not reused. Issue number is not implementation priority.

issue.title: R000B: Expire weather and radar authority using source age as well as retrieval time
issue.body:
<!-- salah-widget-audit-20260907:SW-011 -->
# R000B: Expire weather and radar authority using source age as well as retrieval time

**Repository-local identity:** `R000B` in `theislampill/salah_widget`; existing tracker [#11](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11). The SW identifier is historical draft provenance.


Campaign draft alias: SW-011. Proposed priority P1; product defect. This owner joins the distinct W002 source-age and W003 runtime-retention witnesses because both require the same authority boundary. Publishing this work order neither repairs nor deploys the widget.

## The failure and its evidence boundary

A successful download currently renews weather authority even when it contains old information. Later, a failed refresh leaves the old record available to the precipitation gate indefinitely. The missing contract is therefore **source-valid time → admission → current consumer**, not simply a cache TTL.

The preserved 7 September 2026 controlled-source run executed unmodified bounded functions from main `fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624` and candidate `9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb`. Both produced:

| Input/sequence at clock `2026-09-07T21:00:00Z` | Historical result |
|---|---|
| Successful current payload with `current.time="2026-09-07T17:00"`, UTC request, code 95, precipitation 2, cloud 95 | Source age 14,400 s; retrieval age 0; source time absent from installed weather; gate condition thunder |
| Manifest frame time `NOW/1000-14400`, readable dense tile; download same frame again after 600,000 ms | First pseudo-precipitation 4.3; later frame age 15,000 s but download age reset to 0 and value still 4.3 |
| Cache `{w:{code:95,precip:2},ts:NOW+86400000}` | Accepted at age −86,400 s; thunder |
| Cache timestamp five hours old, load it, advance clock a further 24 hours, reject refresh as offline | Retained weather age 104,400 s; thunder; `wxBusy=false` |

These are Node VM results with controlled Date, fetch, Image, canvas and storage; they are not a 24-hour browser watch, local rainfall measurements or screenshots. The recorded old-source/current and old-frame inputs are independently useful from the outage sequence. A freshness indicator alone cannot repair any of them.

[Weather acquisition and cache](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L761-L840) installs `lastWxAt=Date.now()`, persists `{w,ts}`, retains `fr.time` but checks only radar download age. [Atmosphere](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L1606-L1613) passes retained weather directly to the gate. [Diagnostics](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2050-L2061) report weather staleness without enforcing it. The [candidate acquisition](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb/index.html#L775-L854) has the same causal paths; it is not a repair to cherry-pick wholesale.

Provider semantics were preserved on 7 September, not freshly verified for this work order. [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs) describes model current valid time and a backward aggregation interval: a 900-second precipitation interval is not an instantaneous on-site observation. `generationtime_ms` is processing duration. Local timestamps use the requested zone. [RainViewer](https://www.rainviewer.com/api/weather-maps-api.html) distinguishes index `generated` from frame `past[].time`; frame time dates a mosaic generation, not each contributing radar measurement. Source expiry can reject an old composite; it cannot certify current rain at the selected point.

## Re-anchor and reconstruct RED before editing

In the intended authorized checkout run:

```powershell
git --no-optional-locks rev-parse --show-toplevel
git --no-optional-locks rev-parse HEAD
git --no-optional-locks status --short
git --no-optional-locks diff fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 -- index.html tests/smoke.html DESIGN.md README.md
```

Bind the actual base, dirty paths and final test tree. Read only the named acquisition/cache/consumer hunks; stop and reconcile a changed timestamp, attempt, cache or forecast interface. Do not overwrite unrelated edits or assume an arbitrary future HEAD has this defect.

Build an isolated regression fixture that executes the actual `loadWx`, `fetchWeather`, `fetchRadar`, `radarPrecipNow` and `gateWeatherCode` declarations, with the real timezone converter and controlled dependencies. A fixture which substitutes a corrected gate is invalid. Freeze `Date.now()` to `Date.parse("2026-09-07T21:00:00Z")`, use `lat=24.47,lon=39.61,units="c",tz="UTC",SIM.wx=null,ADVANCING=false`. The current response is status 200 with `elevation:100` and:

```js
current: {
  time: "2026-09-07T17:00", interval: 900,
  weather_code: 95, temperature_2m: 20,
  precipitation: 2, cloud_cover: 95
}
```

Supply two aligned hourly rows if the fixture exercises the current-plus-track refresh shortcut. For radar return `{generated:frameTime,host:"https://tilecache.rainviewer.com",radar:{past:[{time:frameTime,path:"/v2/radar/"+frameTime}]}}` and resolve the controlled image with uniform RGBA `[82,147,196,255]`. This colour is the historical density witness, not a calibrated intensity. Seed the two cache sequences above under `salahwx:24.47|39.61|c`. Preserve the defective outputs before repair. The original private probe is supplementary, not a required public executable.

## Minimal implementation and the decisions it carries

1. **Separate times without introducing a second cache system.** Within existing weather record/envelope ownership retain proposed named metadata `currentValidAt`, `currentIntervalSec` and `retrievedAt`. Retain `frameGeneratedAt=fr.time*1000` and `indexGeneratedAt=j.generated*1000` separately from radar retrieval. These are proposed field names, not fields already present in the source. Keep existing `ts` as the retrieval alias when reading/writing the existing `{w,ts}` cache envelope; add metadata there rather than changing keys or introducing a persisted schema framework. Never set source time from `Date.now()` when metadata is missing.

2. **Admit finite metadata using the agreed temporal interface.** [R000C](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/12) owns measurement/shape admission. This owner consumes its admitted record and verifies finite time/interval semantics and age. Parse current/hourly wall strings through the explicit request-zone converter contract supplied by [R0008](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/8), using the immutable zone captured by [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3). An epoch which is finite only because a nonexistent local time normalized into another time is not accepted. A gap or unresolved fold remains unavailable. Interval must be finite and positive; retain it to describe the period, not to turn it into an extra arbitrary freshness allowance. Frame seconds must be finite and valid before multiplication. Index generation cannot substitute for missing frame time.

3. **Make the initial age policy executable.** Use named constants: proposed current authority maximum 15 minutes, matching existing weather-stale diagnostics/refresh intent; radar retrieval and frame maximum 20 minutes, retaining `_RADAR_TTL`; six hours remains only legacy cache retention, not current authority. Accept age `0 <= now-time <= maximum`, reject maximum+1 ms and any future timestamp. The proposed initial future-skew allowance is explicitly zero, a conservative application policy rather than a provider guarantee. This can temporarily hide otherwise useful data on a skewed client clock; any later nonzero allowance must be a named bounded policy with ±boundary tests and owner agreement, never `Math.max(0,age)`. Do not subtract aggregation duration or index processing time from age to make old data pass.

4. **Enforce the same decision at use.** Introduce one small current-weather selection function reachable from `atmosphere` and `qaState`. In real time it returns the validated, nonexpired current record or unavailable, evaluated from the current wall instant every consumption. Thread that snapshot into `wxDrivers` and the existing direct atmosphere uses for cloud layers, precipitation amount, temperature and wind; otherwise expired rain can disappear from `data-fx` while still driving wetness or temperature. Retain raw record/metadata only for diagnostics/cache inspection. Radar's authority accessor checks source and retrieval ages at every call; repeat downloads can change only retrieval time, so an identical expired frame remains ineligible.

5. **Choose a narrow unavailable presentation.** Expired or timestamp-less real-time records do not supply current weather chip text, a current-condition tooltip or wet/storm effects. Use the existing chip geometry with blank weather values and an unavailable label/title; do not relabel unavailable as measured clear weather or add a new badge. The ordinary neutral sky remains decorative. Leave the prayer footer's stale-state system alone: [its source explicitly scopes that row to prayers](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2014). Preserve SIM overrides and ADVANCING forecast-preview behavior as explicit simulations; real-time may not fall back to hourly weather.

6. **Join cache and consumer changes before relying on them.** A structurally valid older cache with no source timestamp is a compatible cache read but not authoritative weather; leave its bytes intact, allow refresh, and replace the existing envelope only after a valid owned response commits. A cache hit must still allow acquisition of the hourly track. Keep request success bookkeeping distinct from source validity; a recently fetched rejected/old record cannot advance the accepted-current timestamp. Deadline release belongs to [R000D](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/13) and radar evidence meaning to [R000E](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/14); freshness must work with ordinary failure even before timeout integration.

An admission-only check misses the 104,400-second outage witness. Deleting every cache on startup would mask that witness while losing offline compatibility. Treating retrieval time as a source substitute recreates W002. Using a stale weather code plus a fresh radar scalar can still mislabel the present: both the raw current code and any confirming evidence need authority. Keeping stale temperature visibly current conflicts with honest unavailable behavior. These are reasons for the small consumer selection boundary, not a reason to add a provider, service worker or scheduler.

## Final-tree discrimination

All cases below are **future required tests**, not already executed GREEN. Exercise actual acquisition → installed state → `atmosphere`/`paint`, not only an age helper.

| Case/control | Required outcome |
|---|---|
| Four-hour old current and radar; repeat same frame at +10 min | No fresh current/storm authority, distinct source/retrieval ages retained |
| Fresh `21:00` current, retrieval at `21:00`, code 95/precipitation 2/cloud 95 | Eligible current record; existing model-based thunder policy still works |
| Current source and retrieval ages 899,999 / 900,000 / 900,001 ms; radar 1,199,999 / 1,200,000 / 1,200,001 ms | First two eligible, last unavailable under the proposed inclusive bound |
| Missing time, NaN epoch, future +1 ms, cache future +24 h | No fresh admission; no negative age silently clamped to fresh |
| Fresh wet record, advance past bound, reject refresh; then provide fresh wet replacement | Expiry withdraws effects before network recovery; valid replacement restores eligibility |
| Legacy main/candidate `{w,ts}` with valid measurements but no source metadata | No destructive migration and no fresh precipitation; refresh still attempted |
| Invalid/unresolved calendar, DST gap/fold, or interval | No fresh authority from a normalized finite timestamp |
| Real-time current clear 0 plus hourly thunder 95 | Current remains clear; ADVANCING positive control uses forecast and labels its provenance |
| SIM wet/dry scenes | Existing simulated gates work; live radar remains excluded |

The combined temporal fixture must retain hourly `2026-03-08T03:30` from a request in `America/New_York`, change global configuration to `Asia/Riyadh` before completion, and call the converter with the captured New York zone. The required instant is `07:30Z`, not `08:30Z` or a Riyadh-derived epoch. An obsolete attempt still must not commit; a current-generation control may. This is proposed combined acceptance joining [R0008](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/8) qualification and [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3) ownership, not a newly executed historical result. Structural validation by [R000C](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/12) does not discharge it.

Mutation controls in an authorized isolated fixture: replace source time with retrieval time and require the old-current/repeated-frame cases to fail; bypass consumer expiry and require the outage case to fail; read global zone and require the transition/context case to fail. In a disposable browser origin supply the controlled fresh→expired→recovered sequence, capture the weather chip and actual `.c.dataset.fx`, and show no rain/thunder after expiry. Check footer/header readability and fixed 325×530 card; preserve opaque moon and cloud continuity when scenes change. A `qaState` number is supporting evidence, not a visual PASS.

## Integration, compatibility and closure

Exact shared writers are [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3), [R0008](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/8), [R000C](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/12), [R000D](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/13), [R000E](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/14) and [R001E](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/30). One integrator owns shared weather/radar/cache/gate hunks. The existing directed qualifications from admission and timezone conversion remain; no whole-issue sequencing or new dependency is added. Publishable prose can exist before those implementations.

Update [DESIGN weather truthfulness](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/DESIGN.md#L179-L197), [README](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/README.md) and diagnostics through the shared documentation owner: model valid time, interval, retrieval, mosaic generation and unavailable are different. Do not promise ground observation, universal radar coverage or a self-contained offline app. No builder option, config migration, installer, preset or generated distribution edit is required by this repair.

Rollback schema/consumer changes together if healthy supported records become unusable; retain conservative unavailability and cache bytes rather than restore false freshness. Stop on incompatible temporal ownership, unresolved gap/fold semantics, or a policy change beyond these bounded defaults. Partial state such as “metadata retained, consumer still unguarded” is not repaired.

DONE requires exact final-tree RED→GREEN/control evidence, independent review of joined temporal/cache/consumer behavior, and an evidence comment before manual closure. Use non-closing `Implements #N` PR wording. Only claim public repair after matching served-source and consumer readback; otherwise report not deployed. The preserved private companion `basis/finding-records/SW-011.json` is supplemental provenance, SHA256 `f54bdc21ce9316592cf6f7fbaa651faf3b4e69daa0ab0113ef373bceb078bb74`.

Identity provenance: first repository-local allocation batch; existing GitHub object order was used to assign distinct monotonic hex-4 IDs. Closed/held IDs are not reused. Issue number is not implementation priority.

issue.title: R000C: Reject malformed weather measurements without coercing missing values into observations
issue.body:
<!-- salah-widget-audit-20260907:SW-012 -->
# R000C: Reject malformed weather measurements without coercing missing values into observations

**Repository-local identity:** `R000C` in `theislampill/salah_widget`; existing tracker [#12](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/12). The SW identifier is historical draft provenance.


Campaign draft alias: SW-012. Proposed priority P2; product defect. W007 owns value/shape admission at the weather boundary. Source age is [R000B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11), request ownership is [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3), bounded lifetime is [R000D](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/13), and coordinate dispatch is [R001E](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/30). This order does not authorize implementation or publication.

## Why the current boundary is insufficient

The preserved controlled run on main `fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624` and candidate `9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb` found two independently useful RED cases. A well-shaped success payload containing `temperature_2m:null` installed and cached `temp:0`. Separately, a deliberately malformed HTTP 500 weather-shaped body installed code 999, temperature 0, precipitation string `"Infinity"`, NaN site elevation and NaN hourly epoch, and the actual gate classified the result as thunder. The second is adversarial data, not an observed provider incident. The first does not depend on HTTP failure or exotic values.

The code uses `Math.round(cu.temperature_2m)` before distinguishing missing from numeric data; `Math.round(null)` is zero. It does not check `r.ok` before `r.json()`. Presence of `current.weather_code` is sufficient to replace current weather, the elevation uses unary coercion, and hourly arrays are accepted individually as `h[k]||[]`. Consumers then give unsupported code 999 thunder semantics because `wxClass` treats high codes broadly, and unary coercion promotes string Infinity into precipitation evidence. Cached objects bypass even the weak network shape gate.

The exact repair sites are [`loadWx` and `fetchWeather`](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L767-L801), [`wxAt`/`syncWeather`](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L842-L866), [weather drivers](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L869-L898), and [precipitation consumption](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L1432-L1451). There is no `loadWeatherCache` function in the bound source; that prior description meant `loadWx`. [Candidate acquisition](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb/index.html#L775-L815) retains these paths.

Counterevidence matters: HTTP 400 `{error:true,reason:"bad request"}` left `weather=null,lastWxAt=0,wxBusy=false`. This is not a claim that every provider error becomes weather. A current clear code remains clear in normal real time even if the hourly track predicts thunder; the saved advancing-mode control alone adopted forecast code 95. Preserve that distinction.

## Reproduction a cold executor can build

Re-anchor an authorized checkout with `git --no-optional-locks rev-parse --show-toplevel`, `rev-parse HEAD`, `status --short` and `diff fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 -- index.html tests/smoke.html README.md`. Resolve incompatible changes in these exact functions before editing; preserve unrelated dirty files. The unmerged candidate is evidence, not a merge prescription.

Use an isolated source-executing fixture with `Date.now()=Date.parse("2026-09-07T21:00:00Z")`, `lat=24.47,lon=39.61,units="c",tz="UTC",SIM.wx=null,ADVANCING=false`, storage map and controlled fetch. Keep the real timezone declarations. A successful baseline response is status 200, `ok:true`, with:

```js
{
  elevation: 100,
  current: {
    time: "2026-09-07T21:00", interval: 900,
    weather_code: 95, temperature_2m: 20, apparent_temperature: 19,
    relative_humidity_2m: 90, dew_point_2m: 18,
    wind_speed_10m: 2, wind_direction_10m: 180, wind_gusts_10m: 4,
    cloud_cover: 95, precipitation: 2, is_day: 1
  },
  hourly: {
    time: ["2026-09-07T21:00", "2026-09-07T22:00"],
    temperature_2m: [20,19], weather_code: [95,3],
    wind_direction_10m: [180,180], precipitation: [2,0]
  }
}
```

Change only `current.temperature_2m` to null. Historical expected RED is `weather.temp===0` and parsed `salahwx:24.47|39.61|c` cache `w.temp===0`. A separate fixture returns `ok:false,status:500` and:

```js
{
  elevation: "invalid",
  current: {
    weather_code: 999, temperature_2m: null,
    precipitation: "Infinity"
  },
  hourly: {time:["invalid"]}
}
```

Historical observed output is `accepted:true,temp:0,rawCode:999,condition:"thunder",lastWxAt:1788814800000,siteElev:"NaN",trackEpoch:"NaN"`. Assert the installed record, persisted record, track and actual gate; checking only that a parser threw misses the consumer fault. No network provider, private script or full archive is needed for these inputs. The preserved run used Node VM doubles, not browser rendering.

## Ordered repair with explicit partial-data semantics

1. **Validate the transport envelope before mutation.** At the existing fetch boundary reject non-OK HTTP status, malformed JSON, null/non-object root and provider `error:true`. Do not set elevation, current record, track or accepted timestamp before this gate. Preserve a prior valid record only under [R000B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11) validity; rejecting a payload must not renew it. Let [R000D](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/13) own timeout/error cleanup, including a JSON body that never resolves.

2. **Normalize values without coercing observations.** Use a small local numeric-admission function only for the known requested fields: `null`/`undefined` remain unavailable; present measurements require `typeof value==="number" && Number.isFinite(value)`. Strings, booleans, arrays and objects are not numerical weather observations. Round temperature only after admission, so genuine numeric zero remains zero and missing temperature remains null. Finite negative temperatures are valid; do not apply a generic nonnegative rule.

   Admit an integer weather code only from the requested WMO domain `0,1,2,3,45,48,51,53,55,56,57,61,63,65,66,67,71,73,75,77,80,81,82,85,86,95,96,99`; unsupported code makes that current block unavailable rather than dispatching broad range-based thunder logic. For optional quantities, enforce their consumer bounds: humidity and cloud fractions in percent 0–100, direction 0–360, precipitation/wind/gust/visibility nonnegative, and `is_day` exactly 0 or 1 when present. Finite elevation may be negative; an invalid elevation must not replace the prior finite site value/default. Temperature, apparent temperature and dew point have no invented universal climate cutoffs.

   An absent optional measurement is null; an invalid optional measurement is also unavailable with an admission reason. It must not authorize its physical effect. Thus a valid code 95 with invalid/missing precipitation can remain a raw model code but cannot use that missing amount to preserve thunder. Do not silently replace missing precipitation with a recorded “0 mm observation.” The existing fallback behavior for decorative wind/haze is distinct from stored measurements.

3. **Carry units and source metadata as request context.** Preserve request-bound Celsius/Fahrenheit and `wind_speed_unit=ms` when installing values. If a payload advertises unit metadata contradicting the request, reject the affected block rather than relabel numbers; a missing optional units object is not grounds to reject the historical supported fixture because the request already names the units. Do not turn snowfall or other source fields into additional millimetre precipitation proof: the existing gate consumes `precipitation`. Keep the current time string, interval and captured request zone for [R000B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11); this structural owner must not invent an epoch/freshness guarantee. Calendar validity and explicit-zone conversion retain [R0008](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/8)'s contract via the existing shared temporal owner.

4. **Stage current and track independently, commit each valid portion deliberately.** Build normalized objects in locals. A rejected hourly block need not discard valid current conditions; a valid forecast track does not repair an invalid current block and cannot become current weather in real time. Require a nonempty time array whose converted epochs are finite, calendar-valid, strictly ordered and unambiguous under the temporal contract. Require weather-code and temperature arrays aligned to that length; do not silently truncate or sort timestamps. For optional requested arrays, absence becomes an array of nulls of that length; a present non-array or wrong-length array rejects the track, while an invalid optional element becomes null. Missing endpoint values may use the existing available-neighbor interpolation, but two null endpoints stay null, including temperature. Keep categorical codes stepped, never interpolated.

   Update `wxAt`'s final temperature rounding and wind interpolation so optional absence cannot create a recorded 0° temperature or a fabricated measured north wind. Use the existing decorative fallback only at its consumer. Do not expand the forecast range or change the established endpoint-hold behavior; time freshness for real current data is a separate issue.

5. **Use the same normalized-record rules in `loadWx`.** Preserve the existing `salahwx:lat|lon|units` key and readable `{w,ts}` envelope. Validate a cached normalized weather record before assigning it; raw cached `temp:null` is not converted to zero. Malformed JSON/record metadata becomes a cache miss without deleting unrelated storage or preventing the next fetch. Accept structurally valid legacy main/candidate cache values as structurally valid; only [R000B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11) can determine whether missing source-time metadata removes current authority. A numeric zero already saved by older coercion is indistinguishable from genuine 0°: do not invent retrospective provenance or invalidate every legitimate zero.

6. **Make the commit point owned.** [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3) supplies captured coordinates, unit, zone, cache identity and attempt/generation ownership. After asynchronous parsing/validation, verify ownership before installing any portion or persisting the captured cache key. This owner must not independently read mutable global configuration at completion or create a second generation counter. Batch the admitted current record and its timestamp/metadata as one commit so a cache consumer never sees half-normalized authority.

The intended intermediate state is “parsed local candidates, live state unchanged,” followed by “owned valid current and/or valid track committed.” There is no useful partial state in which elevation becomes NaN before current validation fails.

## Controls that distinguish a repair from a stricter-looking parser

Add acquisition fixtures to [the existing smoke owner](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/tests/smoke.html), or a narrow dependency-free source fixture if the current browser harness cannot inject before startup. The file currently tests the pure gate and SIM scenes; those do not exercise fetch/cache admission. Any helper must be called by actual `fetchWeather`/`loadWx`, with an integration case proving reachability.

| Required future input | Required final-tree state |
|---|---|
| Healthy baseline; only temp changed to null, undefined, then numeric 0 | Null/absent temperature stays unavailable in state/cache/render; true 0 displays 0° |
| Negative finite Celsius and Fahrenheit temperatures | Valid values preserved; units remain request-bound |
| Malformed HTTP 500 lookalike above; normal HTTP 400 envelope | No new weather/track/elevation/accepted timestamp; busy eventually released by its owner |
| Status 200 with code 999 or string `"95"` | No unsupported authoritative current block |
| Status 200 valid code with precip `"Infinity"`, NaN, Infinity, −1, then 0 | Invalid values unavailable; no rain authority from them; true zero remains valid dry evidence |
| Current valid/hourly malformed, then current invalid/hourly valid | Valid portion survives; no forecast-as-current substitution |
| Mismatched time/value lengths; invalid/gap/unresolved-fold time; duplicate/decreasing epoch | No usable track installed; future source-age qualification cannot rely on it |
| Optional absent arrays, null endpoints, one valid interpolation neighbor | No NaN geometry/driver or null-to-zero temperature; valid neighbor behavior retained |
| Malformed cached object, then healthy fetch; valid old zero-valued cache | Cache miss recovers; genuine zero remains compatible, subject to freshness qualification |
| Old configuration response completes after new configuration | No install/persist under the new owner; stale finally cannot clear the new attempt |
| Current clear 0 plus hourly thunder 95 | Real-time remains current; ADVANCING positive control uses the forecast track |

In isolated mutation checks, restore `Math.round(null)` and require the minimal null fixture to fail; remove the HTTP gate and require the 500 fixture to fail; bypass cache normalization and require malformed cache to fail; reintroduce `h[k]||[]` and require the alignment/null-endpoint cases to fail. These are future checks, not executed results.

Use a disposable browser origin to render null temperature, genuine zero, malformed precipitation and healthy wet controls. Capture the header chip and actual `data-fx`; no `NaN°`, fabricated 0°, rain/thunder from invalid values, clipped footer or change to 325×530 layout. Preserve existing SIM weather, moon opacity and motion behavior; do not assert those from a parser result.

## Alternatives, integration and completion boundary

Checking `r.ok` alone repairs the adversarial 500 path but misses null temperature, status-200 malformed data and poisoned cache. Rejecting an entire response for every absent optional field breaks supported partial payloads and useful current weather because the historical fixture omits several requested fields. Coercing numeric strings broadens the trust boundary and recreates the Infinity path. A provider-wide schema package or generated validator adds a dependency and cross-provider obligations without helping these known consumers. The small known-field normalizer with explicit partial blocks is the chosen route.

Coordinate shared `fetchWeather`/`loadWx` edits serially with [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3), [R000B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11), [R000D](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/13) and [R001E](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/30). Admission qualifies freshness under the existing relationship; it does not absorb source age or deadline ownership. No new typed edge or write domain is proposed. [README](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/README.md) needs only the exposed unavailable-value behavior; use the shared docs integrator. Builder/config units, installers and preset remain compatible; no generated artifact is expected.

Rollback normalization, cache reader and null-aware consumer changes together if a supported payload fails. Preserve unavailable values while reconciling the precise fixture; never “recover” by manufacturing measurements. Stop on incompatible request/temporal interfaces or disputed unit semantics rather than silently broadening acceptance. DONE requires final integrated RED→GREEN and controls, exact-tree review of admission/cache/consumer reachability, and an evidence comment before manual closure. Use non-closing `Implements #N`. Public repair needs matching served source and relevant UI readback; otherwise it is local and not deployed.

Supplementary preserved companion: `basis/finding-records/SW-012.json`, SHA256 `a51af5aeece94b61ff60f7f456c53f73526be7c3d7f130e73b3265dbf0e58a4b`. All GREEN, browser and mutation cases above remain future requirements.

Identity provenance: first repository-local allocation batch; existing GitHub object order was used to assign distinct monotonic hex-4 IDs. Closed/held IDs are not reused. Issue number is not implementation priority.

issue.title: R000D: Ensure stalled weather requests and radar images release their owned refresh attempts
issue.body:
<!-- salah-widget-audit-20260907:SW-013 -->
# R000D: Ensure stalled weather requests and radar images release their owned refresh attempts

**Repository-local identity:** `R000D` in `theislampill/salah_widget`; existing tracker [#13](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/13). The SW identifier is historical draft provenance.


Campaign draft alias: SW-013. Proposed priority P2; product defect. W005 owns bounded lifetime and resource cleanup of the existing weather/radar attempts. It consumes [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3) request ownership; it does not introduce a scheduler or choose a new weather provider.

## The blocked refresh sequence

Both preserved source trees set `wxBusy`/`radarBusy` before awaiting external work and clear them only in `finally`. If the await never settles, later calls return at the busy guard forever. Advancing the application clock or having a refresh loop is insufficient: the loop reaches a guard that cannot clear itself.

The 7 September 2026 Node VM run bound main `fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624` and candidate `9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb` and recorded:

| Saved controlled sequence | Historical result on both trees |
|---|---|
| Fetch promises for weather and radar never resolve/reject; advance fake `Date.now` 24 hours; call both again | Two fetch calls total, one per source; `wxBusy=true,radarBusy=true` |
| Radar manifest resolves, created Image never calls load/error; advance fake clock 24 hours and retry | One manifest call, one image, `radarBusy=true` |
| Normal image `onerror` | `radarBusy=false` and radar contribution zero |
| Ordinary failed weather request | `finally` releases busy; failure does not renew data |

The fake clock advance is not a claim that a native browser hung for 24 hours. The saved probe does **not** contain a separately executed hung-JSON-body case. That path is source-inferred because the same unbounded function awaits `r.json()`; it must get its own future fixture below. This correction limits the earlier wording “headers/body/image” without weakening the body-lifetime requirement.

The source also demonstrates why blind clearing is unsafe. In the preserved ownership probe, a pending Madinah Celsius request completes after configuration changes to London Fahrenheit; the replacement request is blocked, then the old 20°C value is persisted under `salahwx:51.48|-0.001|f`. A held old radar image can restore 4.3 after the location reset. These W004 outputs belong to [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3) and are an interface reason for this repair, not a second claim to own stale-response rejection.

Read [weather acquisition](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L771-L801), [radar manifest and Image acquisition](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L816-L840), [reset](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2157-L2163), and [existing render-loop refresh call](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2256). [Candidate acquisition](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb/index.html#L785-L854) shares the causal waits.

## Re-anchor and obtain the RED evidence

Before editing an authorized checkout, bind `git --no-optional-locks rev-parse --show-toplevel`, `rev-parse HEAD` and `status --short`; inspect `git --no-optional-locks diff fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 -- index.html tests/smoke.html README.md`. Read only relevant changed functions and stop on incompatible attempt/reset interfaces. Candidate presence is not authority to merge it.

Use actual source functions in an isolated fixture, with controlled fetch, Image, canvas, storage and wall clock. Set `NOW=Date.parse("2026-09-07T21:00:00Z")`, `lat=24.47,lon=39.61,units="c",tz="UTC",SIM.wx=null,ADVANCING=false`. Use these externally observable doubles:

```js
// Headers never arrive:
fetch = () => new Promise(() => {});

// Headers arrive, JSON body never finishes (new required case):
fetch = async () => ({
  ok: true, status: 200, json: () => new Promise(() => {})
});

// Tile remains pending: retain the object but call neither handler.
class HeldImage {
  set src(value) { this.requestedURL = value; heldImages.push(this); }
}
```

For the tile case first resolve status-200 manifest JSON `{generated:NOW/1000,host:"https://tilecache.rainviewer.com",radar:{past:[{time:NOW/1000,path:"/v2/radar/"+NOW/1000}]}}`. Start the actual functions without awaiting their hung promise, flush microtasks, advance only the clock 24 hours, then call again. The historical RED is the table above. A fake clock which changes `Date.now` but never dispatches timers cannot verify the future deadline: the repaired fixture must control timers as well as promise queues and advance both deterministically.

## Ordered lifetime design

1. **Use the existing owner, then attach a lifetime.** Agree the attempt context supplied by [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3): captured configuration/generation, a per-source attempt identity, and a predicate identifying the active owner. These are interface requirements, not names of preexisting functions. Install an attempt in its source's slot before dispatch, so a synchronous failure still owns its cleanup. Busy is derived from that live slot or maintained consistently with it. Never create a separate timer-generation system that can disagree with the configuration generation.

2. **Set named stage bounds.** Use a proposed `10_000 ms` fetch-and-body bound for weather, another `10_000 ms` fetch-and-body bound for the radar manifest, and `10_000 ms` for the tile Image stage beginning when its source is assigned. Thus weather has at most 10 seconds of application wait; radar manifest plus image has at most 20 seconds, not an unbounded timer reset during progress. These are proposed recovery policy constants, not measured provider guarantees. Retain the existing weather minimum retry spacing of 60 seconds, accepted-current/track shortcut of 15 minutes, radar refresh spacing of 10 minutes, and existing approximately 30-second render-loop opportunity to call the self-throttled functions.

3. **Bound the awaited operation itself.** A timeout callback must terminalize the wrapper and release its owner even if fetch or its body ignores abort. Race the entire fetch-plus-`json()` operation against a deadline promise; keep the same timer through headers and body. AbortController is best-effort transport cleanup, not the proof that the promise settles. Observe losing promise rejection so late abort/body errors do not become unhandled rejections. Check the absolute deadline and ownership again before committing; timer delivery may be delayed by a suspended tab.

4. **Make settlement exactly once.** For weather, success/error/timeout/cancel converge on an idempotent finalizer that clears its timer, removes listeners and clears only the slot still owned by that attempt. On timeout mark the attempt terminal before aborting, because abort may synchronously trigger another completion path. Every late success checks terminal state and ownership before touching weather, elevation, track, cache or accepted timestamps. A stale `finally{wxBusy=false}` is forbidden: it can clear a successor's slot even when stale data was correctly rejected.

5. **Cover the Image independently.** Create and retain the Image within the radar attempt. Both handlers, decode/canvas exceptions, timeout and cancellation use one settlement routine. After settlement clear the image timer and detach `onload`/`onerror`. Best-effort stop/clear the image source only in a way verified not to issue a new request in the target browser; detaching handlers alone must not be described as physically cancelling an in-flight network download. A retained old callback invoked after timeout must be harmless. Canvas read failure remains unavailable evidence. The existing error path produces zero; normal load/error must continue to settle without waiting for the deadline.

6. **Preserve eligibility, not false recovery.** The deadline releases an owned slot and records an inspectable reason such as fetch timeout, body timeout or image timeout; it does not mark provider data fresh or assert clear weather. Keep old data only under [R000B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11) source/consumption validity. For unchanged configuration, the next existing eligible poll may retry; no immediate retry loop or new global interval. Configuration supersession can cancel the old attempt and permit the new one under [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3)'s reset contract. Distinguish successful new acquisition from merely releasing a busy flag.

The intermediate states are directly testable: `active(owner,deadline)`; `terminal(timeout|error|cancel)` with owner released; `new-active(newOwner)`; `success(newOwner)` with admitted data. These labels describe a minimal lifecycle, not a proposed exported class or persisted queue.

A bare `AbortController` still depends on the transport/body honouring cancellation. `Promise.race` without cleanup leaves handlers/timers and late writes alive. Clearing the timer after headers misses the body hang. Resetting busy from any finalizer violates ownership. Clearing busy on every render would allow duplicate requests and discard the existing throttle. A provider-wide download manager would add more scope than the two fetch/body paths and one Image require.

## Required deadline, ownership and consumer matrix

The following tests are future acceptance; only the saved header-fetch and tile-hang REDs above were executed historically.

| Case in controlled clock/timer fixture | Expected result |
|---|---|
| Hang weather headers; separately hang weather JSON body | Own busy true at 9,999 ms; terminal at 10,000 ms plus microtask flush; no commit |
| Hang radar manifest headers; separately hang manifest body | No image created; radar attempt terminal at 10,000 ms |
| Manifest succeeds immediately, image hangs | One image; terminal at image deadline; handlers detached |
| Manifest completes at 9,999 ms, image at 9,999 ms into its stage | Healthy owned success before 20-second combined maximum; no timer left |
| Resolve a stage after its absolute deadline before delayed timer callback runs | Reject late commit even if browser scheduling delayed timeout |
| Ordinary rejected fetch, malformed JSON, image error, canvas read exception | Terminal once, timer/listeners removed, unavailable evidence; no unhandled rejection |
| Healthy current/hourly payload and healthy image within deadlines | Accepted once under existing admission/semantic policy; slot released |
| Deadline expires, clock reaches existing retry eligibility, healthy replacement arrives | A new dispatch occurs and real state recovers; retry is not claimed at 10 seconds merely because slot is free |
| Config A cancelled, config B is active, then A timeout/finally/load/rejection fires | B stays busy and owns state/cache; A cannot commit or clear B |
| A succeeds just before deadline, then stale timeout callback fires | Exactly one success; no rollback of its state or clearing a newer owner |
| SIM weather or ADVANCING scheduling control | Existing suppression remains; no new timer/polling subsystem |

For weather retry, use the initial attempt's existing `lastWxTry`: after timeout at 10 seconds, no new call before 60 seconds since that attempt; at the next eligible existing poll a healthy fetch may proceed. For radar, maintain `lastRadarAt` and the 10-minute interval unless configuration supersession explicitly resets it. This issue removes permanent blocking, not normal bounded backoff.

Use isolated mutation controls: remove the body from the raced operation, remove owner-check from cleanup, and omit image timeout in separate variants. Each corresponding case must turn RED. Count active timers and handlers, but also assert installed state, captured cache key, next-call eligibility and late-callback rejection. A helper tested without the production call sites is not evidence.

In a disposable browser origin, hold one request/image, permit the application timeout, then release a healthy eligible replacement. Capture actual weather chip/`data-fx` and network attempt identity; distinguish timeout, slot release and successful consumer recovery. No claim of native cancellation, memory recovery, offline capability or live provider health follows from a Node double. Preserve fixed 325×530 layout, readable header/footer and existing motion/opaque-moon behavior; do not add a status overlay that changes the stack.

## Shared work, rollback and closure

The existing interface edge [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3) → this owner remains. Serially integrate shared acquisition hunks with [R000B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11), [R000C](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/12), [R000E](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/14) and [R001E](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/30). Admission and freshness failures may use this terminal path but keep their own invariants. Existing document lifecycle/render-loop cancellation is retained counterevidence; this issue does not redesign scheduling.

Update [README](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/README.md) and diagnostic descriptions only to state bounded application waits and existing retry opportunities. Browser suspension can delay timer callbacks; immediate wall-clock recovery while JavaScript is suspended is not promised. No builder preference, dependency, persisted queue, installer, preset or generated output is needed.

Rollback lifetime/finalizer edits together if healthy completion regresses; never leave new attempt identities with old unconditional busy clears. Preserve explicit unavailable behavior and recorded failed cases. Stop on missing ownership contract or inability to test delayed/late callbacks; serialize partial state such as “fetch bounded, body still unbounded” as incomplete. DONE requires exact integrated RED→GREEN/control evidence, independent review of timeout/cleanup races, and an evidence comment before manual closure. Use non-closing `Implements #N`. Public recovery claims additionally require matching served source and real consumer readback; otherwise report not deployed.

Supplementary companion `basis/finding-records/SW-013.json` has SHA256 `653d3ae81daa7d9d2edaa4b312c12c4e339e83eee9e68c2ba557526bbcc11a3a`. It preserves W005 and the limits above; this author's prose is not independent PASS.

Identity provenance: first repository-local allocation batch; existing GitHub object order was used to assign distinct monotonic hex-4 IDs. Closed/held IDs are not reused. Issue number is not implementation priority.

issue.title: R000E: Stop interpreting radar alpha density as quantitative storm-strength evidence
issue.body:
<!-- salah-widget-audit-20260907:SW-014 -->
# R000E: Stop interpreting radar alpha density as quantitative storm-strength evidence

**Repository-local identity:** `R000E` in `theislampill/salah_widget`; existing tracker [#14](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/14). The SW identifier is historical draft provenance.


Campaign draft alias: SW-014. Proposed priority P1; product defect. W006 owns the meaning of radar evidence at the sampler/gate boundary. Freshness stays with [R000B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11), lifetime with [R000D](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/13), and request identity with [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3). No provider migration or quantitative rainfall estimator is authorized.

## A documented approximation defeats its own guard

The code already documents an uncalibrated alpha-density proxy. The defect is the stronger claim that it is safe because radar only confirms an existing precipitation code. If the raw model code overcalls thunder, weak radar evidence can prevent the intended downgrade. “Never create rain from clear” is a useful control, but it does not validate the evidence used to retain thunder.

The saved source-executing probe used the provider's scheme-2 Universal Blue palette, a uniform 256×256 tile, the actual 7×7 sampler, current frame time, and `gateWeatherCode(95,{precip:0,cloud:95},radarPrecipNow())`. Both main `fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624` and candidate `9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb` returned:

| Reflectivity row | Provider RGBA | Historical proxy value labelled mm | Final gate code |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| 0 dBZ | `[130,123,105,73]` | 1.2309803921568627 | 95 |
| 15 dBZ | `[136,221,238,255]` | 4.3 | 95 |
| 20 dBZ | `[0,163,224,255]` | 4.3 | 95 |
| 45 dBZ | `[255,68,0,255]` | 4.3 | 95 |
| Transparent/no data control | `[0,0,0,0]` | 0 | 3 |

These are historical controlled RGBA/gate outputs, not measured rain or a local storm. Palette rows and provider semantics were preserved on 7 September 2026 from [the RainViewer colour table](https://www.rainviewer.com/files/rainviewer_api_colors_table.csv) and [maps API](https://www.rainviewer.com/api/weather-maps-api.html). They are not freshly revalidated provider content in this authoring pass.

The cause is exact: [`fetchRadar`](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L825-L837) ignores RGB and counts pixels with `alpha>40`; with at least three returns it calculates `(0.3+4.0*coverage)*meanAlpha`. For a uniform tile coverage=1, so 0 dBZ yields `4.3*73/255`, and every opaque colour yields 4.3. [The gate](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L1432-L1451) takes `max(modelPrecip,radarMm)` and compares it to 0.05 mm and 0.8 mm. An opacity score is thereby treated as the same physical quantity as model interval precipitation.

The public [DESIGN statement](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/DESIGN.md#L187-L197) claims safety under confirm-only/fail-closed. The clear-code control does hold: raw 0 plus radar scalar 5 remains 0. The dry thunder control without radar becomes 3; model precipitation 0.3 downgrades thunder to rain code 63; model precipitation 2 retains 95. Preserve those controls while removing the unsupported comparison.

There is a second limitation, not a new repair owner: the saved sparse fixture uses a dry centre pixel and three echoes at offsets `(3,3),(3,2),(2,3)`. At Madinah and zoom 6, the probe estimates 2,226.282331443378 ground metres per pixel. It returns 0.5448979591836735 and retains raw rain 63. A neighbourhood can contain echoes several kilometres away while the site pixel is dry. This supports cautious terminology; it does not authorize a geographic coverage redesign.

## Re-anchor and reproduce without private infrastructure

Bind authorized checkout root, HEAD and dirty paths using `git --no-optional-locks rev-parse --show-toplevel`, `rev-parse HEAD`, `status --short` and `diff fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 -- index.html tests/smoke.html DESIGN.md README.md`. Reconcile changed sampler/gate interfaces before editing. [Candidate sampler/gate source](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb/index.html) is a preserved comparison, not a whole-branch adoption instruction.

In an isolated fixture execute the actual `fetchRadar`, `radarPrecipNow` and `gateWeatherCode` declarations. Freeze `NOW=Date.parse("2026-09-07T21:00:00Z")` and `lat=24.47,lon=39.61,SIM.wx=null`. Stub fetch with status-200 manifest:

```js
{
  generated: NOW / 1000,
  host: "https://tilecache.rainviewer.com",
  radar: {past: [{time: NOW / 1000, path: "/v2/radar/" + NOW / 1000}]}
}
```

Resolve Image load and have `getImageData(0,0,256,256).data` contain each table RGBA at every pixel. Call `fetchRadar()`, then the gate expression above; reset the fixture or advance 600,001 ms between tiles so the existing radar throttle does not skip them. Repeat with transparent pixels and clear raw code. The specific output values demonstrate the wrong physical equivalence without needing a screenshot to infer it. A public browser crop is still required before claiming rendered correction.

## Chosen minimal route: withdraw unsupported radar authority

Choose fail-closed radar contribution for this repair. Keep model-current quantitative precipitation policy and the raw categorical prerequisite. No new reflectivity decoder or threshold is a hidden prerequisite to close the existing defect.

1. At the existing sampler/accessor boundary, stop producing a precipitation-in-mm authority value from alpha/density. A successful readable tile can retain frame provenance and a clearly unitless diagnostic such as return-pixel count/coverage; it cannot supply the scalar used by the current precipitation gate. Keep fetch/ownership/deadline/source-age behavior in the existing acquisition path so sibling changes do not become stranded. A separate network-elimination optimization is not part of this owner.

2. Update the actual `gateWeatherCode` consumer and diagnostics together. The legacy numeric third argument must no longer preserve rain or thunder merely by being positive; ignore unsupported numeric radar evidence. The gate continues to use an admitted fresh model-current precipitation amount from [R000B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11)/[R000C](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/12). Retaining the callable third parameter as a compatibility shim is acceptable if all numeric radar arguments contribute zero and tests prove that; do not leave an alternate direct caller able to bypass the disabled accessor.

3. Replace misleading diagnostics at [`qaState().wxTruth`](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2052-L2057): `effectivePrecipMm` must describe only supported model interval precipitation under the chosen route. No alpha value may be emitted as `radarPrecipMm`, included in `observedPrecipMm`, or interpolated into `[radar …mm]` downgrade text. For compatibility, the legacy radar-mm field may temporarily remain zero with an explicit unsupported-semantics reason and a unitless provenance/diagnostic field; document the field transition and ensure internal/tests consumers stop depending on a fake measurement. New names are proposed implementation details, not already-present APIs.

4. Correct [DESIGN](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/DESIGN.md#L179-L197), [README](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/README.md), comments and [smoke expectations](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/tests/smoke.html#L116-L121) that call the scalar rain millimetres or “heavy radar.” Explain the public behavior change: model-dry rain/thunder codes previously retained by the proxy now downgrade; fresh model wet evidence remains usable. This is deliberate conservative loss of radar confirmation, not proof that dry weather is observed.

If preserving categorical radar confirmation is required by the future implementing owner, stop at this explicit design alternative before adopting it. It requires demonstrating the actual palette version, RGB→reflectivity decoding, `/2/1_1.png` smoothing/no-data treatment, neighbourhood policy and conservative supported-vs-unavailable decision, with positive and negative fixtures. RainViewer smoothing blends colours; exact lookup on blended RGB can invent values. Reflectivity support alone does not validate on-site rainfall or lightning, and a positive category must never be compared to the 0.8 mm storm threshold. [NWS radar guidance](https://www.weather.gov/iwx/wsr_88d), preserved during the original audit, supports caution about weak/nonprecipitation returns; it does not supply a universal threshold. There is no admitted calibrated categorical positive fixture in this evidence packet, so fail-closed is the executable default.

A tempting weaker fix would rename `mm` to “score” but keep `max` and 0.8 comparisons; that changes prose while preserving the false retention. Raising alpha/count thresholds cannot distinguish the identical-opacity 15/20/45 dBZ tiles. A dBZ-to-rain-rate formula requires calibration assumptions and expands the repair. Removing the raw-code prerequisite would let radar fabricate a storm category and violate an already-passing control.

## Final-tree test matrix and public effects

All following GREEN/mutation/browser checks are proposed, not previously run.

| Fixture/control | Required result for the selected fail-closed route |
|---|---|
| All five palette tiles, raw 95/model precip 0/cloud 95 | Gate 3, no thunder; stored/diagnostic alpha never becomes mm |
| 15 vs 20 vs 45 dBZ identical alpha | No equality claim about physical intensity; all remain unavailable confirmation until justified decoding exists |
| Raw rain 63/model precip 0 plus numeric radar 2 | Gate 3 for cloud 95; legacy numeric argument cannot bypass containment |
| Raw 95/model precipitation 0.3/cloud 95 | Gate 63, preserving model-based downgrade |
| Raw 95/model precipitation 2/cloud 95 | Gate 95 under fresh/admitted current control |
| Raw clear 0 plus any tile or numeric third argument 5 | Remains 0 |
| Three nearby returns with dry centre | No on-site/quantitative claim, no confirmation under this route |
| Transparent/missing frame, image error, canvas failure, SIM | Unavailable radar contribution; no crash or stuck attempt |
| Repeated old frame/future frame/expired retrieval | No authority; retained provenance obeys [R000B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11) and diagnostics do not call it current |

Mutation controls restore the alpha formula's contribution at the accessor and separately restore direct third-argument acceptance in the gate; each must fail the corresponding table rows. A unit test that merely returns zero from a replacement fake accessor does not exercise the source fix.

Use one disposable browser owner to load the actual acquisition fixture with raw 95, model precipitation 0 and uniform 0 dBZ, then a fresh model-wet control. Capture weather chip/title, actual `.c.dataset.fx` and absence/presence of rain/lightning in the appropriate scene. No shader/optics redesign is needed. Preserve header/footer readability, opaque moon, fixed 325×530 layout and ordinary live motion; scalar metrics alone do not certify pixels.

## Boundaries, rollback and DONE

Qualification from [R000B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11) remains explicit for any retained radar evidence; fail-closed default does not secretly remove that accepted relationship. Shared radar/gate writes coordinate with [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3), [R000B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11), [R000D](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/13) and [R001E](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/30); use one integrator for production hunks and shared docs/tests. No new edge, provider, credential, library, builder setting, installer/preset update or persisted schema is proposed.

Containment rollback is to keep radar's gate contribution disabled if replacement semantics remain unproved. Never restore pseudo-mm labels or alpha-as-storm evidence merely to satisfy old tests. If model-wet controls fail, revert the affected gate changes while preserving the unsupported-radar exclusion and expose the failing fixture. Partial state “labels corrected, numeric contribution still active” cannot close.

DONE requires final integrated RED→GREEN and mutation/control evidence, independent review of accessor/direct-gate/diagnostic reachability, and an evidence comment before manual closure. Use non-closing `Implements #N`. Match served source and controlled consumer output before claiming public repair; otherwise report local/not deployed. No real precipitation or storm-observation guarantee is part of acceptance.

Supplementary companion `basis/finding-records/SW-014.json`, SHA256 `14f50398faaf92d4c0bb787be3f321ee971b7f069763133752c6c9a6eeaeea0d`, retains W006 and counterexamples W008/W011/W013/W014. It does not provide a calibrated radar replacement.

Identity provenance: first repository-local allocation batch; existing GitHub object order was used to assign distinct monotonic hex-4 IDs. Closed/held IDs are not reused. Issue number is not implementation priority.

issue.title: R0011: Report settings save and reset outcomes from actual storage results
issue.body:
<!-- salah-widget-audit-20260907:SW-017 -->
# R0011: Report settings save and reset outcomes from actual storage results

**Repository-local identity:** `R0011` in `theislampill/salah_widget`; existing tracker [#17](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/17). The SW identifier is historical draft provenance.


Campaign draft alias: SW-017. Product defect; proposed P2. Scope is the existing settings persistence contract; it is not an erasure feature or implementation authority.

## Observed outcome mismatch

On both main fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 and unmerged candidate 9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb:

- With a saved London configuration and removeItem throwing a DOMException named SecurityError, _resetLocal immediately says "Local settings cleared." After controlled detection failure, it says "Local settings cleared — enter your location." The London record remains readable, and _storageErr is null.
- With setItem throwing SecurityError, changing units to c through _commitSettings still applies units c to the live CONFIG and sets _storageErr to SecurityError. The visible-status field remains "Enter to search a place · Shift+Enter to keep the typed name." Shared saveLocal already returned {ok:false,error:"SecurityError"}.
- README promises that the widget says when saving is unavailable. A separate source census found _storageErr declared, assigned, reset and exposed diagnostically, but no visible outcome consumer.

These are preserved 7 September controlled original-source/DOM results. Lifecycle callees were stubbed in the save witness; no native blocked-storage session or real-user reset was exercised. The result establishes missing caller feedback, not the prevalence of storage denial.

The invariant is: **a save failure preserves the usable in-memory choice and tells the user it is session-only; reset success is reported only if removing the saved configuration succeeded.** A success-shaped diagnostic or a future successful provider request cannot substitute for the storage result.

## Bind the repair and keep the existing storage contract

Before authorized work, record root, remote, HEAD and dirty paths:

~~~sh
git rev-parse --show-toplevel
git remote get-url origin
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
git diff fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 -- index.html config.js README.md tests/smoke.html
~~~

Expect theislampill/salah_widget. Stop on incompatible settings/applyConfig drift. [config.js saveLocal/clearLocal](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/config.js#L153) already catch storage errors and return {ok,error}; successful save additionally returns savedAt. Keep these shapes and the v1 key salah_widget:config:v1. No new storage library or version is required.

The writes are [applyConfig](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2166), [_setStatus and form population](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2283), [_commitSettings/_resetLocal/open/close](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2399), narrowly associated settings feedback markup, and [README persistence wording](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/README.md#L126). [Candidate applyConfig](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb/index.html#L2252) remains comparison evidence.

## Concrete state and staged implementation

The storage operation is synchronous even though applyConfig later awaits prayer loading. Publish its outcome **before the first await**; do not wait for network success to tell the user whether saving worked.

1. Retain a small transient latest persistence outcome at the settings owner: operation save/reset, status saved/session-only/cleared/reset-failed, and error name where present. This is proposed in-memory UI state, not a persisted schema. Reuse _storageErr for its existing diagnostic meaning and derive visible state from the same result. Let a successful later save/removal clear its earlier failure; a routine search hint or opening settings must not clear it.
2. In applyConfig's existing opts.save branch, consume the actual saveLocal return. On failure, publish "Changes apply for this session only. Could not save settings (SecurityError)." using safe textContent with a bounded known error label. On success, retain current origin/source/savedAt behavior and publish "Settings saved in this browser." Continue bindConfig, weather/prayer recovery and rendering on either outcome. Preserve session updates if storage is unavailable.
3. In _resetLocal, invalidate old lookup intent with the current form owner, then call clearLocal once and inspect its return. If removal fails, publish "Could not clear saved settings (SecurityError). Your saved settings remain." and stop this reset attempt before coarse detection or configuration replacement. The failure should not silently turn a saved London profile into a detected session profile. If removal succeeds, publish "Saved settings cleared. Detecting your area…" and run the existing detect path with save:false. A successful detection means "Saved settings cleared — using estimated area: …"; failed detection means "Saved settings cleared — enter your location." These states separately expose storage completion and detection completion.
4. Keep the existing settings close operation synchronous in its visible effect: commit the valid current form, close, restore the opener. Do not await prayer fetch or keep the modal trapped open because storage failed. _populateSettingsForm should show the retained persistence warning together with its ordinary search hint, instead of replacing the warning. A narrow status-composition helper can store the ordinary lookup message separately from the persistence outcome and write the existing #set-status; every existing _setStatus caller must still reach that renderer.
5. Supply a closed-panel indication without moving the card stack. Reuse the existing settings opener's generated .gear element as a warning marker "!" while session-only/reset-failed is current; restore the gear on success. Give the opener a state-bearing accessible name, for example "Widget settings — changes not saved; session only", and a matching title. Preserve the normal "Widget settings" name when no warning exists. Because #set-status is inside the hidden dialog after close, add one visually hidden polite live-status node outside that dialog, updated from the same outcome at the time of save/reset. The marker is a discoverable warning, and reopening shows the complete readable explanation. No toast framework, new modal or card-size change is warranted.

The live-status node and status compositor are justified only by real consumers: failure on close and subsequent reopen. Verify their reachability through _commitSettings and _resetLocal. A hidden node alone does not satisfy visible feedback; a punctuation marker alone does not explain the failure; both the named opener and full reopened status are required.

The alternative of throwing on save failure breaks session-only operation. Keeping settings open changes the documented autosave/close flow and can strand users behind a storage condition they cannot remedy. A status text assignment immediately followed by _populateSettingsForm still loses the message. Treating reset as a purge of all localStorage would exceed the configured-key contract and could destroy unrelated application data. Replacing localStorage or introducing migrations is unrelated to this caller bug.

## Public RED and deterministic matrix

Use original config.js with a Map-backed storage double in an isolated fixture; never alter the owner's actual origin. Load the real settings handlers and applyConfig; stub only provider/renderer lifecycle work where a pure fixture cannot run it. Mark that distinction in results. The decisive storage stimulus is:

~~~js
const bytes = new Map();
const storage = {
  getItem:k => bytes.has(k) ? bytes.get(k) : null,
  setItem:(k,v) => bytes.set(k,String(v)),
  removeItem:k => bytes.delete(k)
};
// Bind this object as the fixture window.localStorage before loading config.js.
// Seed through the production saveLocal before inducing the error:
SalahConfig.saveLocal({lat:51.5,lon:-0.12,label:"London",method:"3",units:"f"});
const oldBytes = bytes.get(SalahConfig.KEY);
// Reset RED:
storage.removeItem = () => { throw new DOMException("blocked","SecurityError"); };
// Click the actual Reset control; inspect status immediately and after any queued work.
// Required: no "cleared" success, oldBytes unchanged, zero new coarse-detect calls.
~~~

For save RED, use a fresh realm; seed first, make setItem throw the same exception, change set-units to c, dispatch input/change and close via the actual close path. Required live CONFIG.units is "c"; saved bytes retain the previous units; _storageErr is SecurityError; session-only feedback is observable without waiting for loadPrayerData.

| Case | Required storage, runtime and UI outcome |
|---|---|
| setItem SecurityError, valid current form | Session update succeeds; old saved bytes stay; warning marker/accessibility text and next-open full warning identify session-only. |
| removeItem SecurityError, saved London | No false cleared/reset message; saved bytes and live configuration remain; no new detection from this failed reset. |
| Successful save after a previous failure | New exact normalized settings are readable through loadLocal, source/origin provenance remains correct; warning clears. |
| Successful removal, detection pending | Config key is absent; cleared-plus-detecting message remains truthful. |
| Successful removal, detection fails | Key remains absent, manual setup is usable, no fabricated estimated area. |
| Successful removal, detection succeeds | applyConfig uses save:false; no accidental resaving of the reset default. |
| Blocked reads, malformed JSON or v2 record | Existing loadLocal null fallback remains; no uncaught error or destructive migration. |
| Unrelated prayer/weather/test key seeded | Save/reset leave those bytes unchanged. Reset is not a claim to erase location caches or provider records. |
| Current form supersedes pending reset/search | [R000F](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/15) rejects stale completion; no old callback clears or overwrites current feedback. |

Positive controls retain all 21 historical pure config assertions as supplementary checks; they already passed before this bug was repaired. Mutation controls remove result checking at save or reset, or restore _populateSettingsForm's unconditional hint: each corresponding UI-through-handler test must fail. Do not call an isolated saveLocal return test whole acceptance.

The minimum native bridge uses one disposable same-origin widget and an iframe fixture. Exercise normal storage once, then deterministically inject denied setItem/removeItem before navigation for denial cases; use real buttons, keyboard close and reopen. Capture the closed opener warning and the reopened readable message, along with CONFIG and saved bytes. Check no clipped status, 325×530 card, readable prayer/footer/header, existing focus wrap and Escape return. Injected denial proves browser DOM/event behavior, not a particular host's privacy policy. If claiming actual TablissNG/third-party behavior, identify its version and permissions and obtain a native host readback; otherwise state unverified. Partitioned storage can be writable within its partition, so documentation must not equate all partitioning with failure.

## Boundaries, rollback and closure

The existing qualification edge from [R000F](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/15) is retained. Serially integrate overlapping settings-event writes with that owner, and applyConfig writes with [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3) so persistence feedback cannot bypass request ownership. No new global request contract is proposed. [R001B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/27) owns the broader recipient/reset disclosure; the documentation integrator joins exact README edits.

README should say: **"Saved settings use this browser's storage. If writing is unavailable, changes still apply for the current session and Settings shows a warning. Reset removes the saved widget configuration; it does not erase prayer/weather caches or data held by external providers."** Do not assert the repaired behavior is already deployed. Builder serialization, installers and preset formats stay compatible. Rendering/physics, date invalid-input behavior and opaque moon remain unchanged, with crops required for the warning's affected geometry.

Rollback only the feedback and reset-result handling delta if successful operations regress; retain saved fixture bytes and do not purge caches as recovery. Keep session-only updates usable. Missing native feedback/readability evidence is a specific partial state, not success. Stop if fulfilling feedback requires a broader layout or host-bridge change; report that for owner review.

DONE requires final-tree RED→GREEN/control evidence at real callers, independent review of close/reopen and reset failure, and an evidence comment binding exact tree and fixture. Public claims additionally need served index/config/README and visible feedback readback. Use non-closing Implements #17 PR wording, then close manually after evidence. This authored proposal is not an independent PASS or a product repair.
