# R001F: Keep coarse-location deadlines active through response-body parsing

**Repository-local identity:** `R001F` in `theislampill/salah_widget`; existing tracker [#31](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/31). The SW identifier is historical draft provenance.


Campaign draft alias: SW-031. Product reliability defect; proposed P2. Scope is coarseDetect's existing two-provider attempt lifetime; this work order grants no implementation or publication authority.

## The timeout ends while the operation is still waiting

The preserved 7 September 2026 source fixture invoked original coarseDetect({timeoutMs:5}) with controlled fetch promises and timers. Both main fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 and unmerged candidate 9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb produced:

| Step | Preserved result |
|---|---|
| Start GeoJS attempt | One abort timer exists. |
| Resolve HTTP headers with {ok:true,json:()=>pendingBody.promise}; leave body pending; drain microtasks | Abort timers become zero; detection result remains unsettled; fetch count stays one. |
| Release JSON body with latitude "24.47", longitude "39.61", city "Madinah", country_code "SA" | Detection resolves ok:true, provider:"GeoJS", source:"coarse-ip", status:"ok"; cfg has latitude24.47, longitude39.61, method"4", units"c". |

The controlled Intl host supplied America/New_York, which remained cfg.tz in the successful result. This is a timezone-precedence control, not a recommendation about timezone or regional method selection.

The five milliseconds were a configured **virtual timer**, not a measured real-network stall duration. The fixture observed the timer removed before firing; it did not simulate a native browser's abort-aware stream. Releasing only the body recovered the result, isolating the missing deadline to body lifetime. Live outage frequency and actual browser recovery remain unmeasured.

[coarseDetect](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/config.js#L174) starts the timer at line192, then clears it at line194 as soon as fetch resolves headers, before returning r.json(). The outer promise can consequently wait indefinitely with no timer to reach ipinfo. [builder detectArea](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/builder.html#L385) remains at "Detecting your area…"; [widget local boot](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2190) cannot reach its intended failure/manual-setup branch. These caller consequences follow from the pending promise; the historical fixture did not prove their rendered pixels.

The invariant is: **each provider attempt remains bounded while awaiting headers and body, then either returns its usable result or advances once to the next provider; exhaustion returns explicit failure so the existing manual path can run.** Completion of headers is not completion of detection.

## Re-anchor and preserve the contract

Before authorized implementation, record root, remote, HEAD and dirty state. Expect theislampill/salah_widget; classify relevant drift before editing:

~~~sh
git rev-parse --show-toplevel
git remote get-url origin
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
git diff fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 -- config.js builder.html index.html tests/smoke.html
~~~

Stop on incompatible provider, parser or caller changes. The [candidate coarseDetect](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb/config.js#L174) has the same historical witness; it is not a prequalified branch to merge.

Write config.js coarseDetect's local next(i) attempt and its narrow regression fixture. Preserve GeoJS→ipinfo order, opts.timeoutMs || 6000, no third attempt, existing fetch options, provider parsing, normalization, source/provider/status fields and timezone precedence. Do not redefine timeoutMs=0, add a new provider or change valid-coordinate/region policy as part of timer repair. Exhaustion must remain {ok:false,source:"coarse-ip",status:"failed"}.

## Minimal staged implementation and observable states

1. Keep the timer alive through fetch→HTTP check→r.json()→provider parsing/normalization. Remove clearTimeout from the headers callback. Successful headers now leave the provider attempt pending with its timer still owned by that attempt.
2. Give timeout a terminal result as well as abort cleanup. Inside next(i), race the full existing local work chain against a local deadline promise. The deadline callback rejects that promise and aborts that attempt's controller. This guarantees logical fallback even if a controlled or noncooperating body promise ignores abort. No global scheduler or reusable transport framework is needed.
3. Clear the attempt's timer only after the race settles. Success returns the existing result; failure clears then invokes next(i+1) once. Never let an old attempt's completion clear the next provider's timer. Keep normalization and result construction local to work; no UI, storage or global config adoption occurs before the winning return.
4. Leave late work attached to handled promises. Its eventual resolution/rejection cannot emit another result, start another fallback or become unhandled. Abort requests transport cleanup; it does not prove a custom transport actually stopped. The attempt can be logically failed while an obsolete noncooperating body remains unresolved.
5. Keep callers' contracts unchanged. Builder can show success/failure using its current intent; widget boot can open manual settings on explicit exhaustion. Any late result arriving after a new form choice must still be rejected by [R000F](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/15). Do not make this timer the form's ownership mechanism.

Design pseudocode for the existing next(i) body, not an executed patch:

~~~js
var ac = new AbortController(), to;
var deadline = new Promise(function (_, reject) {
  to = setTimeout(function () {
    reject(new Error("coarse location timeout"));
    ac.abort();
  }, timeoutMs);
});
var work = Promise.resolve().then(function () {
  return fetch(p.url, {
    signal:ac.signal, mode:"cors",
    referrerPolicy:"no-referrer", cache:"no-store"
  });
}).then(function (r) {
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error("http " + r.status);
  return r.json();
}).then(function (j) {
  // Keep the existing p.parse, coordinate checks, normalize,
  // and success result construction here, unchanged.
  // This chain has no UI/config/storage side effects.
});
return Promise.race([work, deadline]).then(function (result) {
  clearTimeout(to);
  return result;
}, function () {
  clearTimeout(to);
  return next(i + 1);
});
~~~

The final patch must retain the actual parse/return body in the commented position; a missing return is not an implementation. This local race has two real consumers already identified above, so no exported helper or new config field is justified.

Simply moving clearTimeout to final settlement and relying on native fetch abort is a credible smaller alternative **for an abort-aware native Response body**. It must be qualified with the actual stalled-stream browser case. It will not settle the historical abort-ignorant deferred body fixture unless that fixture models abort. The explicit deadline result is chosen here so the promised operation bound remains testable without conflating those two instruments. A fetch-only race repeats the headers/body gap. One global timeout would reduce the fallback provider's existing opportunity; indefinite retry or a new provider expands scope.

Timers cannot preempt synchronous CPU-bound JSON parsing or a blocked event loop. The guarantee is termination of asynchronous waiting once the event loop runs the deadline callback, not a hard wall-clock execution limit through arbitrary synchronous work.

## Public RED/GREEN fixture

Publish the regression source with the later repair. The following proposed fixture invokes actual config.js and supplies the decisive public inputs; it does not require a private audit probe or live provider. Save it as a narrow authorized test and run node tests/coarse-deadline.cjs from the tested checkout:

~~~js
const fs = require("node:fs");
const vm = require("node:vm");
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
function deferred() {
  let resolve, reject;
  const promise = new Promise((a,b) => { resolve=a; reject=b; });
  return {promise,resolve,reject};
}
const drain = async () => { for (let i=0;i<20;i++) await Promise.resolve(); };
(async () => {
  const timers = new Map(), requests = []; let serial=0;
  const context = {
    URLSearchParams, AbortController, Intl,
    setTimeout(fn,ms) { const id=++serial; timers.set(id,{fn,ms}); return id; },
    clearTimeout(id) { timers.delete(id); },
    fetch(url,opts) {
      const d=deferred(); requests.push({url,opts,...d}); return d.promise;
    }
  };
  context.window=context;
  vm.createContext(context);
  vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync("config.js","utf8"),context);
  let completions=0;
  const result=context.SalahConfig.coarseDetect({timeoutMs:5})
    .then(value => { completions++; return value; });
  await drain();
  assert.equal(requests.length,1);
  assert.equal(timers.size,1);
  const body=deferred();
  requests[0].resolve({ok:true,json:()=>body.promise});
  await drain();
  // Historical RED: timers.size is 0 here; result is still pending.
  assert.equal(timers.size,1,"deadline must survive headers");
  assert.equal(completions,0);
  const [id,timer]=[...timers.entries()][0];
  assert.equal(timer.ms,5);
  timers.delete(id); timer.fn(); // fire the first provider's virtual deadline
  await drain();
  assert.equal(requests[0].opts.signal.aborted,true);
  assert.equal(requests.length,2,"exactly one fallback");
  requests[1].resolve({ok:true,json:async()=>({
    loc:"51.5,-0.12",city:"London",country:"GB",timezone:"Europe/London"
  })});
  const value=await result;
  assert.equal(value.ok,true); assert.equal(value.provider,"ipinfo");
  assert.equal(value.cfg.lat,51.5); assert.equal(value.cfg.lon,-0.12);
  body.resolve({latitude:"24.47",longitude:"39.61",city:"Madinah",country_code:"SA"});
  await drain();
  assert.equal(completions,1); assert.equal(requests.length,2);
  assert.equal(timers.size,0);
})().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode=1; });
~~~

This is new proposed test text, not a rerun or claimed PASS. It intentionally uses an abort-ignorant body to distinguish timeout-result ownership. Use the exact source's required globals if a later compatible config module needs them; do not replace the production function with test logic. Keep provider fixtures finite/valid, and preserve the historical released-body success as a separate positive control.

| Additional deterministic case | Required final state |
|---|---|
| Healthy GeoJS body before expiry | One request, existing GeoJS success shape, timer removed, no fallback. |
| Headers never resolve | First deadline still advances once to ipinfo. |
| HTTP non-ok, rejected JSON/invalid JSON, or existing parser's unusable-coordinate case | Cleanup then existing fallback; no invented successful location. |
| Both provider attempts reach their virtual deadline | Exactly two requests; result ok:false/source:"coarse-ip"/status:"failed"; no active timers or third request. |
| Body callback settles before deadline; reverse ordering in a separate case | First actual settlement wins. Schedule both explicitly; do not depend on a flaky simultaneous real-time race. |
| Old body rejects after fallback succeeds | No unhandled rejection, duplicate fallback or changed returned result. |
| New form intent during first/fallback attempt | Old result/status cannot alter that form or its saved/exported configuration. |
| Restore clearTimeout at headers in an isolated mutation | The deadline-survives-headers assertion becomes RED again. |
| Remove explicit deadline rejection with abort-ignorant body | Logical-settlement/fallback assertion fails, demonstrating why abort alone is insufficient for this instrument. |

Do not claim the Map timer fixture proves native stream cancellation. The minimum browser bridge serves an isolated local response endpoint that sends successful headers and begins an incomplete JSON body, then withholds the remainder. Redirect the two known provider URLs to local fixture routes before loading config.js, while retaining native fetch/AbortController/Response body behavior. First route stalls; second returns the healthy ipinfo body above. Observe first-request abort, one fallback, result and cleanup. Add a finite streamed GeoJS control. Close only fixture-owned requests/server resources afterward; never induce a real provider outage.

Finally invoke actual builder detectArea and a fresh disposable widget #local=1 boot. Two provider failures must produce the builder's manual/precise recovery guidance and the widget's manual settings/render-loop path. Capture the relevant UI crop; a helper's return value alone cannot prove usable manual recovery. No host storage or geolocation prompt is needed. Native browser/event-loop version and fixture identity belong in the evidence; a Node result cannot certify a specific embedding host.

## Integration, compatibility, rollback and closure

The sole repair domain remains config/coarse-detection. Its existing qualification edge from [R000F](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/15) is unchanged. [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3) owns remote request/config adoption, [R0006](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/6) prayer liveness, [R000D](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/13) weather/radar transport and [R0011](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/17) settings reset feedback. Similar timeout needs do not justify merging these owners or adding a global transport abstraction. No relationship delta is proposed.

Builder/index are consumer tests; edit them only for a demonstrated necessary caller-contract adjustment. Preserve successful source/provider/accuracy/area fields, timezone and country mapping, local/hash/saved priority, v1 saved configuration, cache compatibility and all installer/preset payloads. Keep 325×530 layout, header/footer readability and ordinary visual behavior. README recovery wording changes only if the actual repaired behavior requires clarification; no "bounded operation" or public recovery claim before its readback.

Rollback timer/race/fallback edits as one coherent unit if healthy detection regresses. Do not retain only a header-time cleanup while declaring the deadline fixed. Stop on incompatible caller/provider drift or an unapproved broader transport design. Source-only or virtual-only evidence remains partial where native/browser recovery is claimed.

DONE requires final integrated-tree RED→GREEN, positive/boundary/mutation controls, the native streamed-body and actual-caller checks, and independent exact-tree review of cleanup and one-fallback ownership. Add an evidence comment binding tree, fixture, schedules, outcomes and limits. Public claims additionally require matching served config.js/callers and the recovery readback. Use non-closing Implements #31 PR wording and manual closure after evidence. This work order asserts no executed product or independent PASS.

Identity provenance: first repository-local allocation batch; existing GitHub object order was used to assign distinct monotonic hex-4 IDs. Closed/held IDs are not reused. Issue number is not implementation priority.

issue.title: R0020: Make default real-time mode follow device wall-clock corrections
issue.body:
<!-- salah-widget-audit-20260907:SW-032 -->
# R0020: Make default real-time mode follow device wall-clock corrections

**Repository-local identity:** `R0020` in `theislampill/salah_widget`; existing tracker [#32](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/32). The SW identifier is historical draft provenance.


Campaign draft alias: SW-032. Existing corrective owner: GitHub #32. Proposed priority P1; product-or-skill defect. The main repair target is `fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624`; audit `9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb` is comparison evidence, not an assumed future target. This work order authorizes no implementation, commit or publication.

## Captured divergence and the missing clock authority

The widget has one public temporal source, but ordinary mode does not keep that source aligned with the device wall clock. `initSim()` records Date.now once. `simNow()` then adds only monotonic elapsed time until the timezone changes. NEW-HP-001's exact-source fixture moved Date.now and performance.now independently: unchanged clocks had zero skew; a +3600000 ms wall correction left `simNow-Date.now=-3600000`; a −3600000 correction left +3600000. ET-NEW-001 corroborated the same defect with ±7200000 ms plus one second of monotonic elapsed time. These are two witnesses of one invariant, not two clock owners.

The old formula is arithmetically consistent with its old anchor. Its defect is using that retained anchor as ordinary **current device time** after the device has corrected itself. Prayer/current-event selection, countdown, civil day, sun/moon date and day acquisition consume this instant; changing only a text clock would leave the product state wrong. There is no evidence here of an actual NTP incident, an observed user's error duration, a measured correction frequency, a native suspend result, or a rendered/public repair. Historical results used exact temporal source in controlled Node environments and did not change the machine clock.

DST elapsed arithmetic remains [R0007](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/7), conversion of explicit local times remains [R0008](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/8), and day/late-response/Hijri semantics remain their existing owners. This issue supplies the correct current instant and discriminating consumer cases.

## Re-anchor and resolve explicit timeScale=1 from the actual contract

Before edits, record `git -C C:\workspace\ai\salah_widget rev-parse --show-toplevel`, `rev-parse HEAD`, `status --short`, and `diff -- index.html DESIGN.md tests/smoke.html`, with the same `git -C` prefix. Compare [main initialization/mode helpers](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L694-L726), [loop and visibility](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2224-L2273), and [candidate temporal source](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb/index.html#L709-L744). Stop on incompatible relevant drift; unrelated work remains untouched.

The existing code distinguishes an absent `timeScale` parameter from an explicit positive one: `ADVANCING = _tsParam!=null && TIMESCALE>0`. Explicit `timeScale=1` therefore already selects preview behavior: [hourly forecast synchronization](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L861-L866), [star reprojection](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L1983-L1985), [SIM readout](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2032-L2034), and the loop's forecast/refresh/fast-class branches. [DESIGN's parameter contract](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/DESIGN.md#L246-L250) expressly says a timeScale parameter enables ADVANCING, forecast weather, reprojected stars and the sim clock.

There is a conflicting shorthand comment: “1 → real time.” In context that states the **rate**, while the executable parameter-presence branch and documented preview effects distinguish mode intent. The chosen minimal repair preserves explicit `timeScale=1` as a 1× anchored preview. It fixes only ordinary no-clock-override loads. This is an evidence-based compatibility choice, not an assertion that the old wording was unambiguous. Clarify the comment and DESIGN: absent clock overrides follows current device time; explicit `timeScale=1` remains a 1× preview with its existing preview behavior. Do not use this issue to change ADVANCING/weather semantics or silently reinterpret existing preview URLs.

## Exact mode table and smallest source design

Define the authority predicate once, beside existing parsed flags. Proposed code below is design, not an implemented patch:

```js
const FOLLOW_WALL_CLOCK =
  _tsParam == null && SIM.time == null && TIMESCALE === 1;

function simNow(){
  if(FOLLOW_WALL_CLOCK) return Date.now();
  if(_simBase == null || _simTz !== tz) initSim();
  return _simBase + (_RAFNOW()-_rafT0)*TIMESCALE;
}
```

Integrate the converter owner's explicit invalid-simulation guard around the explicit branch; do not reintroduce a numeric old anchor after a rejected scene. The predicate has no persisted state and no new query field. It deliberately distinguishes parameter presence from the numeric rate.

| Inputs after existing parsing | Clock authority | Existing visible/data mode retained |
|---|---|---|
| No simTime, no timeScale | Current Date.now on every call | Ordinary real-time; no new ADVANCING flag. |
| Explicit timeScale=1, no simTime | Initial anchor plus monotonic elapsed ×1 | Existing 1× preview/ADVANCING and SIM readout. |
| Explicit timeScale=60, no simTime | Initial anchor plus monotonic elapsed ×60 | Existing accelerated preview. |
| simTime=03:30, no timeScale | Resolved explicit anchor, scale 0 | Frozen scene remains frozen. |
| simTime=03:30 with scale 1 or 60 | Resolved anchor plus configured elapsed rate | Explicit scene remains independent. |
| Explicit scale 0, empty/invalid scale parsed as 0, or clamped negative scale | Existing frozen parsed mode | Do not broaden this task into query-parser validation. |

1. Put the ordinary branch before any retained-anchor initialization. A zone change changes how an epoch is displayed, not the real epoch itself; ordinary mode need not call `initSim` merely because `_simTz` is stale. Leave explicit simulation's intended zone-settling initialization in place. Do not repeatedly reanchor its elapsed base every frame.
2. Keep `nowParts()` and `simDate()` on the same `simNow()` entry point. Do not add separate “real date,” “prayer clock” and “sky clock” authorities or call Date.now directly throughout the renderer. A current default-mode call must observe either direction of a wall step immediately. The existing `sec!==_lastSec` loop comparison schedules rendering after either positive or negative second changes; preserve `!==`, not `>`.
3. Make consumer decisions with the ordinary current instant on their next existing scheduled render. [R0007](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/7) owns a coherent model snapshot for endpoint subtraction. There is no requirement to introduce a global frame cache or another rAF loop here. A subsecond correction within the same integer second can be shown at the next normal second tick; the fixture must not claim a callback occurred when the loop was paused.
4. On forward/backward civil-day corrections, preserve the day-adoption contract from [R0005](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/5): derive the actual current local day, classify completed cache/prefetch and late data by their admitted dates, and mark an unmatched retained record stale/unavailable. Do not increment the configuration generation on every clock read. A same-generation pending response can still have the wrong day after a correction, so [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3) generation guards are necessary but not sufficient.
5. The candidate's future-Hijri hold is not automatically adopted into main. If the final integrated date-output owner uses a hold, [R0009](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/9) must disclose it correctly after a backward step rather than silently calling a future date current. The clock repair must not hide its restored ability to move backward behind a monotonic display clamp. Shared consumer evidence may qualify both owners without moving their source ownership here.
6. Preserve real-elapsed operation eligibility and busy ownership under [R0006](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/6). A wall correction should change the relevant civil day, not cause one request per frame or postpone an otherwise eligible retry by an hour. `_RAFNOW()` uses performance.now on the normal supported browser path; where its existing fallback is Date.now, independent-simulation/monotonic guarantees require actual host qualification and are not inferred from Node stubs.
7. Retain the existing visibility and IntersectionObserver stop/start behavior. A hidden document does not need a timer to keep updating output; its first resumed callback reads the current wall instant and performs at most the existing eligible day/acquisition work. Do not run a catch-up render or request for every missed second/day. Actual native sleep/wake is a separate environment pathway and cannot be declared fixed from injected clock steps alone.

Periodic blind reanchors would destroy frozen/accelerated scenes. A new “NTP detector” or correction threshold invents policy not needed by the witness. Keeping only monotonic time preserves the defect indefinitely. Changing ADVANCING to hide the explicit-1 difference would alter forecast/stars/UI behavior outside scope. Direct Date.now for the default branch is smaller and exact for the specified authority.

## Public deterministic RED → GREEN fixture

The following **proposed** fixture controls only its VM Date/performance objects. It does not alter the host clock or execute a private probe. It extracts the actual temporal block; preserve its source hash and stop if markers are missing. Each test creates a fresh realm so one mode's anchor cannot contaminate another.

```js
const fs = require('node:fs'), vm = require('node:vm');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const source = fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8');
const a = source.indexOf('const _RAFNOW =');
const b = source.indexOf('// ---- prayer-times data:',a);
assert(a >= 0 && b > a);
const block = source.slice(a,b);
const base = Date.parse('2026-09-07T12:00:00.000Z');
function check(query, step, expected){
  let wall=base, mono=0;
  class ClockDate extends Date {
    constructor(...args){ super(...(args.length ? args : [wall])); }
    static now(){ return wall; }
  }
  const q=new URLSearchParams(query);
  const c=vm.createContext({Date:ClockDate, Intl, q,
    SIM:{time:q.get('simTime')}, tz:'UTC',
    performance:{now:()=>mono}, pad:n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0')});
  vm.runInContext(block,c);
  const read=()=>vm.runInContext('simNow()',c,{timeout:5000});
  read(); // establish the explicit-mode anchor before either clock changes
  mono=1000; wall=base+1000+step;
  assert.equal(read(), expected(wall));
}
for(const step of [0,3600000,-3600000,7200000,-7200000])
  check('',step,wall=>wall);
check('timeScale=1',3600000,()=>base+1000);
check('timeScale=60',3600000,()=>base+60000);
check('simTime=03:30',3600000,
      ()=>Date.parse('2026-09-07T03:30:00.000Z'));
```

The default positive/negative assertions fail on the historical source by exactly the injected step; unchanged clock is the positive control. The explicit-preview assertions preserve its existing independent anchor/rate. The timeout is fixture containment, not a production clock deadline. Repeat negative wall steps for explicit modes and SIM.time+scale; each must remain independent on the supplied monotonic performance fixture. Also assert default `nowParts()` is 13:00:01 or 11:00:01 UTC after the respective one-hour step, proving that wall parts consume the corrected instant.

## Required caller and browser controls

An isolated browser fixture must inject its test Date/performance functions **before** the widget script executes, then supply deterministic provider responses and storage. Use a same-origin disposable document or test runner's pre-script hook; changing a `window.Date` object after the IIFE has already captured state is not equivalent setup. Record the served source hash and actual hook installation, invoke the real boot/render/loop, and capture DOM output. A detached Node function test does not prove browser consumer integration.

Use a synthetic admitted UTC September 7 record with Fajr 05:00, Sunrise 06:00, Dhuhr 12:00, Asr 15:30, Maghrib/Sunset 18:00, Isha 19:30, matching Gregorian fields and UTC metadata. These are fixture inputs, not a real site's prayer prediction.

| Controlled transition | Required actual consumer result |
|---|---|
| 15:29:59 → 15:30:01 wall step, fixed monotonic time | Next scheduled visible render changes current prayer from Dhuhr to Asr; next key becomes Maghrib, and countdown consumes the new instant. |
| Reverse to 15:29:59 | Current/next selection can return to Dhuhr/Asr; no only-increasing second guard or display latch. |
| September 7 23:59:59 → September 8 00:00:01 with completed day 8 prefetch | Day 8 is adopted through its owner, accepted date/cache identity is day 8, and output is not stale day 7 labeled current. |
| Hold a day 7 request through that forward step | A late response cannot be relabeled day 8. Old completion also cannot release a newer owning request slot. |
| Step backward from day 8 to day 7, then release a pending day 8 response | It can qualify as nextDay when eligible, never as current day 7. Date/Hijri output retains truthful provenance rather than a hidden future hold. |
| Hide, advance fixture wall clock, then show | First resumed callback uses current device time, with one existing eligible acquisition opportunity, not a catch-up storm or second loop. This is simulated visibility evidence, not native sleep. |
| Explicit timeScale=1/60 or frozen simTime, with wall steps | Anchor/rate and existing ADVANCING/forecast/stars/SIM readout behavior remain as declared in the mode table. |

Capture corrected now, current/next labels, selected/loaded dates, cache writes and attempt ownership at each release point, with a crop of actual clock/prayer/date output. Preserve existing valid-scene 325×530 readability, opaque calendar moon, visible live motion, reduced-motion behavior and offscreen pause. No cloud hash may substitute for motion evidence. Native suspend or device-correction claims require actual supported-host observations if later selected; they are not prerequisites to claim only the bounded injected wall-correction pathway with its stated limits.

Mutation controls in an authorized disposable fixture restore the old boot-anchor formula, broaden the default predicate to explicit simTime, and change the loop's `!==` to `>` separately. Default step, explicit frozen, and backward-render cases must respectively fail. Restore the final tree before qualification. A test that mocks nowParts directly cannot qualify whether nowParts consumes the repaired simNow.

## Interfaces, docs, rollback and closure

No new predecessor or graph edge is proposed. Preserve qualification from this owner to [R0007](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/7) and [R0009](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/9), and shared `runtime/clock-mode` / `runtime/render-loop` writes with [R0005](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/5), [R0006](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/6), [R0008](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/8). The request/day fixture consumes existing ownership contracts; it does not transfer their repair scope. One integrator joins overlapping production hunks.

Change only the clock authority predicate/branch, necessary consumer integration, comments and invoked fixtures. Update DESIGN's [one-formula description](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/DESIGN.md#L87-L95) to retain one temporal API with two explicit authorities, and clarify the 1× preview distinction at the existing parameter documentation. No new clock preference, builder field, config/preset migration, installer, dependency, OS setting, active IMPLEMENTAUDIT state or notification feature belongs here.

Rollback the narrow predicate/consumer integration if explicit modes or accepted day behavior regress. Keep the default defect open rather than mask it with a monotonic Hijri clamp. Partial source arithmetic success cannot close #32 while consumer/date/explicit-mode controls fail. Final-tree RED→GREEN/control evidence, independent exact-tree review and browser consumer readback precede an evidence comment and manual closure; use non-closing `Implements #32`. Public repair claims require matching served source/readback. Supplementary historical companion SHA256: `a265910ff3eed52bfb640fabef7ae2c7c35dc24899e364d1349b081c5901c7bf`. No new execution result is asserted by this plan.

Identity provenance: first repository-local allocation batch; existing GitHub object order was used to assign distinct monotonic hex-4 IDs. Closed/held IDs are not reused. Issue number is not implementation priority.

issue.title: R0021 — Keep sky-object reveal coherent through initialization and twilight
issue.body:
# R0021 — Keep sky-object reveal coherent through initialization and twilight

Canonical identity: **theislampill/salah_widget R0021**. Investigation baseline: `fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624`. This is a future implementation work order; publication does not implement it or authorize a commit/deployment.

The first visible sky can briefly show a small moon growing into its final slot, or a night moon/stars before a daytime sun and atmosphere settle. During normal twilight, the moon's group fade can also reveal background stars through its disc. The target is coherent object reveal/withdrawal with independent stellar occlusion, followed by the existing settled motion. This is not a request to remove animation or redesign astronomy.

## Present behaviour and evidence

The [static moon](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L461) starts at `translate(250 64) scale(.62)`. [renderMoon](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L1055) writes approximately`translate(268.5 57.4) scale(1.13)` for the investigated crescent. [CSS](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L158) transitions transform for1.6s. The sun separately transitions transform for2.4s. [Boot](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2181) creates stars/weather/moon before prayer acquisition completes and the atmosphere is painted.

In a detached native-boot capture, the moon's first sampled matrix at6.5ms was scale0.622648; it reached1.13. Screenshots showed the growth. A transform-transition-only knockout removed it. Four later identical fresh-document reloads reproduced the growth once; three began at settled scale. Storage-cleared/800ms-provider-delay cases did not reproduce growth but exposed uninitialized layer timing. Thus this is intermittent first-style-resolution behaviour, not a claim that every cold load animates the moon. A daytime capture showed the night moon and stars before the sun and daytime atmosphere appeared.

The original native-entry simulation used `units=c` without `simTemp`, so its default72°C exaggerates atmospheric warmth. A supplementary24°C low-sun sequence still exposed initial night moon/stars before the daytime scene settled. Its night sequence and four further24°C reloads began at final scale1.13, without growth. Thus growth was observed intermittently in the original fixture, not reproduced by this ordinary-temperature control; no temperature causation or universal startup frequency is claimed. The day-layer initialization finding has an independent24°C control. Settled weather comparisons supplied explicit finite temperatures.

The application is static HTML/classic JavaScript, without a framework hydration phase. CSS defaults, style resolution, cached data, synchronous drawing and asynchronous provider completion are the relevant boundaries. DOM metrics alone do not certify the first compositor frame; future qualification needs a visible sequence as well.

The later owner night-sky addendum adds a demonstrated ordinary-twilight boundary to this same appearance invariant. At05:40 in the pinned fixture, sun elevation−5.6066°, moon group opacity0.521 and star group0.195 coexist. Inserting a3px white background star atSVG(270,70) changed moon-interior pixels by up to23/255; the outside-star control changed up to50. At05:20, moon opacity1 hid the same interior probe completely while the outside control remained visible. A detached independent star-layer mask removed the interior leak while retaining the moon fade. This is a positive/negative pixel control, not a claim that an arbitrary real star was observed through the moon outdoors.

Source inspection also finds `buildStars` projects before asynchronous local coordinate resolution and sets `_starsProjected=true`; later ordinary render can retain the initial fallback projection. Bind initial star geometry to the accepted target/time, including local/no-saved mode. This source-traced path needs its own runtime control; no fresh GPS/IP location was requested in the investigation.

## Desired invariant and scope

Before a sky object/layer is visibly exposed, its position, size, visibility and light eligibility belong to the same accepted scene. Unresolved data yields a bounded truthful neutral atmospheric state, not a visible transit through arbitrary CSS defaults. During twilight appearance/disappearance, the moon may blend naturally into the sky, but stellar occlusion must not fade into transparency while the disc is visible. Once initialized, normal live and source-driven transitions retain their current purpose.

Own initialization/reveal coordination for sun, moon, stars, clouds and weather layers, including config reinitialization, plus the evidenced moon/star twilight reveal and occlusion boundary. Do not redesign settled geometry, textures, colour palette, clock, source admission, prayer cache or location selection. Do not hide the entire widget until every network request or font succeeds. Prayer information and a neutral unavailable state must remain usable if weather/radar is absent.

## Implementation sequence

1. Re-anchor current HEAD/status and read the actual boot/config/paint/scheduler writers. Retain the failing sequence; record source bytes, viewport, font readiness, cache state and request timing. Check whether prior owners changed those boundaries before adopting this baseline's line numbers.
2. Define the smallest initial-scene commit boundary. Derive solar/lunar geometry and eligibility from the accepted target/time, stage initial CSS/SVG/canvas values with transitions suppressed only for initialization, then enable ordinary transitions after those values have been committed. An equivalent architecture is acceptable if it proves the invariant without a second renderer or timeout-based guess.
3. Keep unavailable source states explicit and finite. Weather need not be ready to show a coherent astronomical scene; unresolved location may require a neutral scene. First initialization must not inherit stale prior-location rain. Reuse existing configuration/attempt identity rather than creating another generation system.
4. Include default CSS visibility, accepted initial star projection and cloud/weather canvas readiness in the same reasoning. Fixing only `.moon` transform does not address the daytime moon/star flash. Preserve later cloud arrival as a supported weather update; the bug is exposing an unresolved initial scene as already authoritative.
5. Separate stellar occlusion from visual lunar fading during twilight. A star-layer mask/clip or equivalent compositing treatment may preserve a delicate moon fade without admitting stars through it; derive geometry from the actual rendered disc, including glints and Milky Way behind it. The disposable51px centre mask is only a mechanism control, not approved edge geometry. Check anti-aliasing and avoid a dark circular cutout. Do not solve this by making the moon pop on/off or by globally extinguishing all stars too early.
6. Add narrow entry/twilight captures/tests, update high-value comments and DESIGN/ARCHITECTURE/HANDOFF statements affected by the boundary. Keep no-build/static embedding and325×530 dimensions.

## Reproduction and discriminating controls

Serve an unchanged disposable copy. For a controlled night case use the hash `lat=24.47&lon=39.61&tz=Asia%2FRiyadh&label=Madinah&method=4&units=c&seed=1&simTemp=24&simHumid=55&simWind=3&simTime=22:00&simWx=2&simCloud=30&simMoon=0.08&simWax=1&simMoonAlt=20&simMoonH=42&motion=full`. Pin date2026-09-08 in a test-only pre-script; explicit Date arguments keep normal semantics. Stub Aladhan timing requests for that date/next day with Fajr04:46/04:47, Sunrise06:05, Dhuhr12:19, Asr15:48, Maghrib/Sunset18:33, Isha20:03, timezoneAsia/Riyadh. These are repeatable synthetic records, not prayer/calendar certification. Run zero and800ms response delay, warm and cleared test-origin storage. Block unexpected live provider input. Never clear a user's normal widget origin.

Use a **new document**, not only a changed hash: simulation and motion flags are read at boot. Preserve native CSS transitions in the entry case. Start rAF sampling at DOMContentLoaded for at least3.5s; sample computed transforms/opacities and moon image readiness; capture a screenshot sequence or recording covering the same interval. Repeat identical documents because baseline growth is intermittent. Add a day case at12:30 and low sun18:10; stars and night moon must not appear as settled daytime content. Inspect the final card in each case.

Controls: unchanged baseline; transition-knockout diagnostic to isolate the size mechanism; deliberately delayed/unavailable prayer/weather; supported positive rain and dry/no-evidence weather; reduced motion and explicit full-motion new documents; later valid weather/config change. Do not treat a frozen `simTime` still as live-motion proof: run an additional real elapsed15–60s sequence with a live clock and accepted synthetic weather.

Twilight controls: clear finite synthetic weather, phase0.01/0.08/0.5/1, altitude20°, dawn04:40–06:20 and dusk18:10–19:30 on the pinned date. Sample the opacity overlap densely around05:40 and the equivalent dusk elevation; inject the interior star at(270,70) and a separate outside control at(100,80), radius3. Compare identical before/after disc-interior and edge crops. Fully opaque night must reject the interior probe; daytime must have no false calendar-moon hole. Inspect an actual continuous transition as well as settled checkpoints before claiming natural fade timing. No abruptness was established merely from the sampled baseline envelopes, so retain their broad timing unless comparison justifies a change.

## Acceptance and evidence limits

- The previously reproducible growth and daytime night-layer flash are absent in repeated cold/warm entry sequences; sampled initial visible geometry equals the first accepted scene, and pixels agree.
- Missing/delayed providers produce a coherent usable neutral/partial-data state without an indefinite blank widget or false precipitation. Recovery shows the current target's scene.
- Settled crescent/half/gibbous/full/new/below-horizon moon retains opaque textured calendar presence at night; daytime stays appropriately hidden. No stars through the lunar disc. The sun keeps its defined nucleus, low-left entry, flattening and visible-source optics.
- Twilight moon/star entry and exit remain gradual and coherent; background stars/glints cannot transmit through the visible moon during its fade, and no mask creates a black cutout or daytime hole. First local-mode projection uses accepted coordinates, never a fallback0/0 scene left behind after resolution.
- Clouds/rain retain their scene linkage; full live motion remains visibly present over15–60s where appropriate; reduced-motion preference still reduces it. The cloud hash is not motion evidence.
- Header/buckle/footer/prayer layout and325×530 embed bounds survive. Native browser/at least one mobile or constrained embed entry should be checked before broad compatibility claims; desktop evidence alone is scoped accordingly.
- No permanent extra render loop, per-frame allocation, network wait for appearance, guessed sleep-to-ready or global transition ban is introduced. Compare startup duration and steady-state callback count/cost against the baseline.

One watched screenshot sequence plus meaningful initial-state assertions is stronger than many tests mirroring CSS constants. Failure to reproduce in one run does not close an intermittent issue. Retain failing and non-failing controls, browser/DPR/cache/timing records and actual before/after crops in the implementation evidence.

## Ownership, ordering and rollback

[R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3) owns accepted async configuration/attempt results; [R0004](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/4) owns resolved-location boot day; [R0008](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/8) and [R0020](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/32) own clock contracts. This issue consumes those states and does not implement their repairs. [R001D](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/29) owns consumed lunar diagnostics. [R0017](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/23) owns smoke accounting/storage isolation. Existing CLOUD-001/FUI-09/Plan07 refresh/day/wind continuity is a different, still-held lead.

No semantic prerequisite forces all32 fixes before this visual change, but qualification must use accepted fixture inputs and reconcile overlapping boot/paint writers. R0022 owns physical light eligibility and per-star wash consumption, while this owner owns visibility/occlusion; neither grants calendar transparency. Serialize integration with those moon/atmosphere changes in `index.html`; use one visual preview driver. Filing order is not implementation order. A richer catalogue, magnitude-based stellar emergence and routine sidereal positional drift remain separate held aesthetic/local-sky directions.

Rollback the initialization coordination as one small patch if it causes blank/loading deadlock, stale-location appearance, lost motion or layer opacity regression. Do not broaden into a full renderer rewrite to rescue the patch. Done means the exact integrated candidate has entry and settled-state evidence meeting the invariant, with limitations recorded; filing this work order is not done.

issue.title: R0024 — Separate current precipitation evidence from nearby, approaching and forecast states
issue.body:
# R0024 — Separate current precipitation evidence from nearby, approaching and forecast states

Canonical identity: **theislampill/salah_widget R0024**. Baseline `fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624`. This work order defines a bounded evidence/classification implementation. It does not select or certify a radar arrival engine, add a provider, authorize production deployment or promise forecast accuracy.

The current WMO/amount gate cannot represent dry-at-point with rain nearby, uncertain current evidence, or forecast rain later. It uses a confirm-only `max(current, radar proxy)` for precip-coded weather. The product needs separate current, spatial and short-horizon concepts so the renderer cannot turn a nearby or future cell into local falling rain.

## Actual baseline and why existing repairs are insufficient

[fetchWeather](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L771) requests Open-Meteo current plus hourly values; [syncWeather](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L859) uses hourly only in accelerated preview. That current/preview separation must survive. Open-Meteo current is a weather-model product; minutely timestamps outside native domains may be interpolated hourly output. [provider contract](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs).

[Radar](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L803) samples one latest zoom6 tile's clipped7×7 alpha neighbourhood. At latitude24.47°, pixel pitch is about2.226km and full sample width15.584km; at52.52°,1.488km and10.418km. Three full-alpha returns/49 give a0.545 “mm” proxy even if the centre is dry. [R000E](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/14) already owns withdrawing that unsupported quantitative authority and explicitly permits a separately qualified categorical alternative, including dry-centre negative controls. Do not reopen or duplicate it.

[The gate](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L1435) keeps raw clear/model0/radar1 clear, keeps model rain1/radar0 rainy, and can keep a rain code wet using only nearby radar proxy. [wxTruth](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2052) lacks explicit nearby/approach/forecast/unknown state. Fixing finite values, stale clocks or radar units does not by itself supply this product distinction.

Fresh research on2026-09-08 found RainViewer future radar discontinued, history limited to2h/10min, max zoom7; live manifest had13 past frames and an empty nowcast array. [current transition](https://www.rainviewer.com/api/transition-faq.html). A MET Norway browser probe succeeded for Oslo with radar quality metadata, but a regional adapter and empirical skill remain later work. This issue must remain useful without either source enhancement.

## Selected bounded contract

Implement a small pure reconciliation over admitted evidence, separate from rendering. Preserve WMO as one provider input, not the sole atmosphere authority. Return independently:

- **Current:** supported wet, supported dry, model-estimated wet, model-estimated dry, conflicting or unknown.
- **Spatial:** nearby precipitation evidence, observed-area no nearby echo, or unavailable.
- **Short horizon:** approaching with supported arrival interval, nearby without supported arrival, numerical forecast only, none supported or unknown. Imminent is a horizon-qualified approach; it is never current wet.
- **Forecast:** source/product, valid interval, amount with units and optional probability with its event/window.
- **Renderer permissions:** local rain/snow and lightning permissions derived from admitted present evidence, with reason and expiry.

These are conceptual data states, not predetermined UI wording. Current and approaching may coexist. Unknown/no evidence is not dry; a missing probability is not0%; a nonzero forecast amount is not an observed rate. Avoid an arbitrary weighted confidence score or numerical probability labels without calibration.

For this first implementation, existing Open-Meteo current maps to **model-estimated** wet/dry after R000C/B admission. The withdrawn alpha proxy supplies no evidence. Nearby/approach remain **unavailable** until an adapter is independently qualified. Do not invent approach from hourly weather, current surface wind, proximity alone, an empty future-frame array or15-minute interpolation. This explicit unavailable state is a successful outcome of this bounded state/renderer work order, not delivery of the separately requested useful local rain-arrival capability. A later bounded source-qualification increment must establish which present/nearby/approach claims an actual provider supports in a declared geography; that increment is not selected or implemented by this issue. Do not synthesize an ETA to disguise the distinction.

Local falling precipitation requires separately admitted present-condition evidence at the selected target with source/time/location quality adequate for that claim. This stage therefore suppresses strong local rain/lightning effects where the only live evidence is a coarse/model estimate; it preserves useful model temperature/cloud/visibility and describes its uncertainty. That behaviour change is intentional under the owner's stronger truthfulness requirement. It must not be labelled “confirmed dry.” Synthetic renderer QA can explicitly grant positive evidence in a marked simulation lane; production cannot inherit that permission.

The source-adapter interface must not be a free boolean `trusted:true`. An admitted record identifies provider/product, target generation, measurement/valid interval, frame/issue/receipt times as available, units, spatial footprint/coverage, documented quality status and a versioned admission-policy reason. Existing sources in this stage cannot self-upgrade to strong current wet. A later provider-specific implementation must supply positive/negative fixtures and source-quality rules before that category can be emitted live. Consume the existing R000B/R000C/R000E contracts explicitly: a RainViewer composite-generation time is not a per-radar observation time, and nominal coverage does not establish operational negative evidence. Preserve unknown local observation age/health. Retain quantity kind and units: a preceding-15-minute amount at16:30 spans16:15–16:30; converting0.4mm to1.6mm/h gives an interval average, not instantaneous rain or onset. These are source-admission refinements, not a new provider or weather repair owner. [RainViewer contract](https://www.rainviewer.com/api/weather-maps-api.html), [Open-Meteo variables](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs).

## Dependency-ordered implementation

1. Re-anchor current source and existing repairs. Consume [R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3) request/target ownership, [R000C](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/12) finite admission, [R000B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11) freshness and R000E radar authority. They remain separately owned; do not call their future contracts already implemented. Their relevant consumer interfaces are qualification prerequisites.
2. Consume [R0023](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/35) location target/intent/accuracy/acquisition-age contract. A fixed site is not necessarily a device fix; unknown IP accuracy is not a made-up radius. Model-grid spatial support remains separate from coordinate precision.
3. Add a compact evidence record and pure reconciliation with explicit availability/rejection reasons. Use physical units and time intervals; retain nulls. Preserve source time versus receipt time and source generation. A source gap cannot extend an old wet lease by resetting receipt time.
4. Connect current live inputs to model-estimated/unknown categories. Maintain accelerated preview in its explicit synthetic/forecast mode. Add structural nearby/approach/forecast fields without new network calls; unavailable is the default until a qualified source exists.
5. Derive renderer permissions and a concise truthful information state. No falling rain, snow or bolt from approaching/forecast/unknown alone. Do not replace all atmosphere with a blank scene: admitted present/model cloud, temperature, visibility and humidity still supply appropriately described atmosphere. A forecast-like thunder code and rain amount are not a lightning observation.
6. Make `qaState().wxTruth` explain the consumed decision: target/source/accuracy/fix age, source valid/receipt ages, coverage/quality, point versus surrounding evidence, classifications, source rejection/unavailability, renderer permissions/reason/expiry and arrival derivation only when present. Omit full tiles and redundant forecast arrays. No remote telemetry or continuous location tracking.
7. Update actual public weather semantics, source attribution and supported diagnostic documentation. No field-study export, sample-collection programme or general telemetry/harness framework is required or in scope.

## Decision fixtures A–G and controls

Use deterministic admitted-evidence records, not the owner looking outside. Preserve each source's provenance and reject undefined “high confidence” shortcuts.

| Fixture | Required result |
|---|---|
| A: qualified current wet evidence at precise target, model dry | Current supported wet with disagreement recorded; original clear WMO cannot veto independently admitted current evidence. In the initial implementation this is a synthetic adapter-contract fixture, not a live RainViewer claim. |
| B: qualified usable negative evidence, model rain | Current supported dry or conflicting according to the adapter's explicit negative-evidence policy; never universal radar-always-wins. Model estimate remains inspectable. |
| C: dry point, nearby echo with qualified movement/arrival | Current dry/uncertain remains separate; nearby/approach has its own interval; local particles stay off. Unqualified movement yields nearby only or unavailable. |
| D: radar absent/outside coverage, model rain | Model-estimated wet plus observation unavailable; neither confirmed dry nor strong local rain. |
| E: radar18min old, fresh model | Evaluate source-time policy; fresh download does not rejuvenate old evidence. No tight ETA from old/missing trajectory. |
| F: coarse-IP/unknown accuracy versus precise target | Spatial/point claim admission differs when warranted; do not assert viewer precipitation from a centroid. Preserve evidence at the configured site separately. |
| G: weak/interpolated/ambiguous returns | Uncertain/unavailable categorical evidence, never mm or calibrated drizzle from alpha. |

Additional controls: null versus zero; current rate versus prior15-minute amount; future interval labelled current; model native versus interpolated minutely metadata; probability versus amount; empty radar under no coverage; dry centre/three wet neighbours; stale after tab resume; changed location with old response/history; rain-end clearing and source outage; simulated positive rain/thunder versus identical live forecast-only input; current rain plus later approaching cell simultaneously; a fresh composite with stale/unknown underlying local observation age; nominal coverage with absent/unknown operational health. The latter cases must not acquire strong negative/current evidence merely from fresh transport and a covered pixel.

Render those decisions in the actual325×530 card. Positive synthetic current rain retains cloud-linked particles; dry/nearby/approach/forecast/unknown controls do not emit them. Do not hide uncertainty by showing a clear-weather icon that implies confirmed dry. Preserve existing sun/moon/cloud quality, header/footer/prayer information, reduced motion and readable status. UI wording may be compact, but the information needed to distinguish current from predicted/unknown cannot exist only in a debug object.

## Arrival and source boundaries

No production motion estimator, minutely fetch, regional provider or predicted cloud direction is included here. RainViewer's historical map pixels can support later motion research, but radar returns aloft are not guaranteed ground rain. Regional nowcasts may be stronger when quality flags are usable. Numerical15-minute fields can corroborate prediction; they do not observe approach. A future adapter must document coverage, update/valid/receipt clocks, CORS/deployment origin, limits, attribution, bytes/cache/battery and graceful degradation before granting live evidence.

A demonstrative motion calculation is not validation: at1km/pixel,4px per10min implies24km/h; a10km leading edge would arrive in25min under unchanged translation, while20km location uncertainty alone adds about±50min. Turning, growth, decay, new convection, gaps and frame latency require wider intervals or abstention. No exact17:40 claim follows from an hourly forecast.

## Acceptance, evidence limits and rollback

Pass when all states remain distinct through acquisition→reconciliation→diagnostics→visible renderer, A–G behave as above, no unsupported source grants current particles, positive synthetic current evidence still exercises the renderer, and existing interface/clock/expiry tests pass on the integrated candidate. Measure extra CPU/memory/network against baseline: this stage adds no provider requests and needs no per-frame inference; reconcile when evidence/time eligibility changes.

No field-study programme, owner weather observations, sample/event collection or periodic taste check-ins are required. Qualification uses automated decision fixtures, lawfully available recorded provider responses, synthetic conflict/motion cases and bounded API/browser contract checks. Real-world predictive skill remains unestablished where it has not been measured; neither arithmetic controls nor an all-dry API smoke certify it. Do not turn that evidence limit into an unrequested study deliverable or claim this state scaffold delivers an arrival service.

[R000D](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/13) remains source-body/image lifetime owner; [R001E](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/30) owns zero-axis queries; [R001B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/27) owns network-recipient disclosure. Existing radar/current correctness issues are unchanged, not absorbed. New renderer richness consumes this state and must not drive it. Shared `index.html` weather/atmosphere/diagnostic writers require one integrator; serialize with location and lunar/entry work at their interfaces.

Rollback a new evidence source/approach classifier to explicit unavailable/model-estimated states if validation fails. Never restore alpha-mm authority, convert unknown to dry or retain local rain merely to keep a dramatic scene. Stop and narrow if implementation needs paid infrastructure, continuous GPS, a general state framework or an unvalidated ETA to close this issue. Done is the honest state/renderer contract with exact-candidate evidence; arrival accuracy and future provider qualification remain separate work.

issue.title: R0025 — Preserve established cloud continuity across wind updates and day boundaries
issue.body:
# R0025 — Preserve established cloud continuity across wind updates and day boundaries

Canonical identity: **theislampill/salah_widget R0025**. Investigation baseline: `fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624`, index SHA-256 `446453b522f56f5f1bc0afd1a3abd09b73756754fa58a6b3b0ff09ce953a2eec`. This is a future implementation work order. Filing does not implement it or authorize a commit, deployment, dependency or renderer rewrite.

A small wind refresh can rearrange an already-established cloud field because current velocity is multiplied by absolute epoch time. A separate UTC-day seed switch replaces the procedural population. Preserve the existing soft layered morphology and visible motion while making those ordinary updates continuous.

This promotes the retained **CLOUD-001 / FUI-09** lead after new source-bound pixel evidence. The associated Plan 07 is `plans/round-4/07-adaptive-performance.md`, a held cadence/performance plan; it is not the historical moon-optics or motion-telemetry plan numbered 07. Its adaptive governor, battery probe, visibility refactor and moon/star optimizations are not selected here.

## Source mechanism and discriminating evidence

[Cloud identity and painter](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L1501) use a location/explicit-seed base plus `Math.floor(t/86400)*3.13`. The resulting seed drives placement, lifetime, wander and radius. At UTC midnight it changes the population rather than merely translating it. In Madinah that boundary is 03:00 local, not local midnight.

[Horizontal phase](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L1559) contains `wind*t*(0.024+di*0.006)`, with `wind=cloudState.wx*cloudState.wspd` and `t=simNow()/1000`. [applyCloudState](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L1797) writes wind directly; it eases coverage, not phase. A velocity change at fixed epoch T changes the pre-wrap phase by `-T*k*deltaWind`. Wrapping bounds the position but does not preserve continuity. Multiplying a smoothed velocity by epoch still has that dependency; replacing epoch with session age only makes the error grow with session duration instead.

The independent HELP v2 contribution and a separate Windows in-app Chromium 152 replay exercised the actual source painter and the actual `weather.wind → render → applyCloudState` path. The local replay used native 144×232 cloud canvases, a 325×530 card, loaded Inter/Fraunces, effective viewport 394×614 and reported DPR 2.2800001188. It was a detached synthetic fixture, not a live-provider refresh or an elapsed watch of midnight.

| Local source-bound control | Pixels with any premultiplied RGB channel delta >5/255 | Mean absolute premultiplied RGB delta |
|---|---:|---:|
| Wind 3.0→3.1 m/s, same instant, baseline | 5,520 | 8.7111 |
| Same update, accumulated-phase diagnostic | 0 | 0 |
| Initial baseline versus initial phase diagnostic | 0 | 0 |
| Unchanged baseline versus no-op cloud canvas | 0 | 0 |
| 76 ms straddling UTC seed boundary | 6,571 | 14.5450 |
| Ordinary 76 ms, same source/state, away from boundary | 0 | 0.08678 |

The raw before/after images visibly show masses relocating; these figures are a discriminator, not a calibrated perceptibility threshold. Premultiplied RGB avoids treating hidden colour under transparent pixels as visible change. The independent container run gave slightly different raster counts but the same separation. Full-card no-op pixels were not exact; only the cloud controls above receive exact-parity credit. No `qaState().clouds.hash` is used as motion proof.

The diagnostic initializes each deck phase to the baseline's existing wrapped phase and subsequently integrates elapsed time. Zero elapsed time produces no displacement when velocity changes. It leaves daily reseeding and other policies unresolved, rejects backward time, and updates from inside the cluster loop. **Do not paste this control into production:** skipped/empty decks, long gaps and same-frame repeated calls need explicit handling; applying a newly received velocity to a whole unobserved gap would recreate a retroactive-motion error. Initial parity isolates the mechanism, not a complete implementation.

## Reproduce without private artifacts

Serve an unchanged disposable copy of the pinned source and its `config.js`. Use a fresh document with:

```text
#lat=24.47&lon=39.61&tz=Asia%2FRiyadh&label=Madinah&method=4&units=c&seed=1&simWx=2&simTime=18:10&simMoon=0.08&simWax=1&simMoonAlt=20&simMoonH=42&simTemp=24&simWind=3&simHumid=55&motion=full
```

In a test-only pre-script pin no-argument Date/Date.now to 2026-09-08 at 18:10 Asia/Riyadh; preserve explicit Date-argument behavior. Stub the two Aladhan timing responses for September 8/9 with Fajr 04:46/04:47, Sunrise 06:05, Dhuhr 12:19, Asr 15:48, Maghrib/Sunset 18:33, Isha 20:03, timezone Asia/Riyadh. These are synthetic repeatability records, not calendar certification. Block unexpected live weather input; never clear a user's normal origin or acquire their location.

After fonts, both day records and embedded moon texture are ready, supply the complete synthetic weather object: `temp:24, feels:24, rh:55, dew:15, wind:3, windDir:225, gust:5, rain:0, showers:0, snow:0, isDay:1, src:'sim', code:2, cloud:50, cloudLow:25, cloudMid:50, cloudHigh:22, precip:0, vis:18000`. Set `weatherTrack` and `weatherRadar` to null, `siteElev=0`, reset `_cloudReady=false` and the three live cloud coverages to zero, then render the first accepted fixture scene. In this painter experiment alone suppress CSS transitions and freeze animations at the same 1,250 ms phase. Let the compositor consume the state, stop the disposable rAF chain, and explicitly paint at `T=1788880200` seconds. The following imperative probes can be injected in a disposable classic-script test scope that can access source lexical bindings; they are not new production APIs.

1. Save `_cloudCv.toDataURL()` and a full card screenshot after `paintClouds(T)`. Record the whole `cloudState`.
2. Set `weather.wind=3.1`; call `render(); paintClouds(T)` and save again. Check that the three coverages, light/tint inputs, coordinate and T are unchanged; only the relevant normalized wind speed changes. The investigated `wspd` changes from 0.1711111111 to 0.1755555556.
3. In a fresh baseline document, hold cloud state fixed and paint at `B−0.038` and `B+0.038`, with `B=1788912000` (2026-09-09 00:00 UTC). Compare an ordinary pair `B−1`, `B−1+0.076`. Save raw RGBA PNGs, composite both over the same background, and inspect actual before/after images. Label amplified difference panels as such.
4. Repeat baseline/no-op and first-image parity for a proposed phase change. Compare positive-time constant-wind travel too: a frozen sky is not a repair. Preserve rejected and non-reproducing controls rather than tuning a threshold to force green.

## Desired behavior and bounded design

For an already accepted target and explicit visual seed, an ordinary wind update changes subsequent travel, not accumulated position. Crossing a civil/UTC day boundary does not replace the population. Continuous lifecycle/wander and meaningful 15–60 second motion remain. A deliberately selected new target or explicit simulation seek is a different operation, with a documented coherent reset/reconstruction policy.

Use the smallest scene-local identity, phase and visual-time state needed. Keep the current puff construction, colours, coverage mapping, canvas dimensions, wind-driven artistic speed and cloud-linked rain columns as the baseline. This is not a density-field backend, sun-coordinate repair, atmospheric-palette replacement or adaptive performance governor.

1. Re-anchor source/current owners and retain the failing controls. Read the actual painter, coverage writer, loop, reduced-motion branch, config reset and time providers before editing. Do not assume an old line anchor is still current.
2. Give the established population a stable scene identity based on accepted target plus explicit visual seed. Retaining the initial day's seed as an initialization ingredient is acceptable; changing it each midnight is not. Existing slow lifecycle variation can provide variety without population replacement. A crossfade between populations is an alternative only if evidence justifies its extra complexity and avoids double cloud mass.
3. Advance bounded displacement once per deck/time step, independent of how many clusters happen to paint. Integrate velocity over an explicit elapsed visual interval; document old/new/trapezoidal sampling and units. Equal-time repeated paint is idempotent. An empty deck returning must not acquire all missed displacement at the newly sampled wind. Keep state finite/bounded without modulo-wrap jumps in visible geometry.
4. Separate illustrative visual elapsed time from civil truth where needed. [R0020](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/32) owns wall-clock corrections; this owner must consume that contract without retroactively multiplying changed time/velocity or freezing the prayer/solar clock. Inspect lifecycle and wander as well as x phase. For hidden/reduced-motion periods choose a bounded resume/rebase policy; never replay an unbounded backlog or jump from the reduced-motion painter's constant timestamp into epoch phase. Explicit accelerated simulation/seek needs a deterministic documented reset/reconstruction rule, not an accidental negative-delta exception.
5. Keep coverage interpolation behavior unchanged unless this implementation moves its update cadence. If cadence changes, use elapsed-time response with a stated reference: the existing `C+=.08*(target-C)` at one-second intervals corresponds to `tau=-1/log(.92)` seconds. Analytical equivalence is not evidence that this response is artistically optimal. Preserve coherent first accepted coverage under R0021; do not add a long fake-empty introduction. A general adaptive scheduler remains held Plan 07 scope.
6. Recompute `_colDens` from the actual visible population and retain `tieRainToClouds` alignment. Never smooth precipitation permission past source expiry, across a location change, or from nearby/forecast weather into present particles. Clouds may evolve smoothly while rain permissions change immediately under their separate truth contract.
7. Add narrow behavior/visual regression tests and update affected high-value continuity/time comments and renderer documentation. Preserve no-build embedding, 325×530 geometry, opaque PBR calendar moon, honest dawn, registered solar optics, prayer information and accessibility motion preference.

## Qualification and stopping conditions

At the exact integrated candidate, retain original-source failing images alongside candidate controls. Test same-time speed changes, heading changes, calm/reversal/gust inputs, repeated paint at equal time, an inactive deck becoming visible, and continuous positive-time motion. Test ordinary versus boundary steps at UTC day/month/year changes. Model state assertions and painter pixels must agree; do not require every browser to match one platform's exact antialiasing count.

Run an actual 15–60 second live-clock sequence with finite synthetic weather, at realistic nonzero wind, showing travel and lifecycle change. Frozen `simTime` or a changed hash does not establish elapsed motion. Inspect current/new/below-horizon moon and clear, broken, overcast and positive synthetic rain scenes for unintended consequences; particles must still originate from the cloud columns. The unchanged clear-sky canvas is a useful negative control.

Exercise hidden/resumed and reduced/full-motion transitions, normal wall-clock corrections and explicit forward/backward simulation seeks separately. Scope tests to the chosen policy; a seek may deliberately reconstruct a scene, whereas an ordinary wind refresh must not. Repeated resume must not arm multiple loops. Target change must start the new accepted scene without carrying old-location precipitation or disguising it with a fade. Use mocks and disposable fixtures; no owner observations, periodic taste check-ins or field-study programme.

Measure steady-state painter cost and retained state on one quiescent setup before and after; do not infer GPU/battery gains from JavaScript self-time or compare a parallel capture batch as a benchmark. No extra provider requests, unbounded history, per-cluster persistent allocation or permanent extra render loop should be needed. Broaden only if a concrete regression warrants it.

## Ownership, sequence and rollback

The wind and day mechanisms share this one established-scene continuity objective. [R0021](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/33) owns initialization/reveal and twilight stellar occlusion; its historical held-cloud reference points to this lineage, not another cloud owner. [R0022](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/34) owns physical moonlight eligibility; consume it without changing the calendar disc. [R0005](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/5) owns schedule-day adoption, [R0008](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/8) simulated civil-time interpretation, and R0020 ordinary wall-clock authority. None owns cloud displacement/population continuity.

[R0003](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/3) remains async target/attempt ownership. [R0024](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/36) remains precipitation evidence and renderer permission. Existing finite-input/freshness/radar owners remain prerequisites at their interfaces, not work absorbed into this issue. [R0017](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/23) owns smoke accounting/storage isolation. UI contrast/calendar owners remain unchanged.

No blanket dependency on finishing all 36 owners is created. Qualify with explicit accepted synthetic inputs and serialize integration at overlapping `index.html` painter/loop/config writers; combine entry, lunar-light, time and weather regressions at those interfaces. Plan 07's broader cadence/governor work stays held and must later consume this continuity contract.

Rollback the small population/phase/time patch if it causes frozen wallpaper, edge-wrap popping, runaway retained state, inconsistent simulation, lost rain-column linkage or incorrect accepted-target behavior. Keep the failing fixtures and honest status; do not rescue it by adding an unrelated renderer framework. Done means demonstrated continuity and retained motion on the integrated candidate, not a passing diagnostic, an authored plan or publication of this issue.
